question: For each academic year, provide the academic year description and the total number of units for all subjects offered in terms with a term status of 'Previous', where the total number of units is greater than 100, and only include subjects offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18). sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 100 ), SubjectCounts AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(*) AS total_subjects, COUNT(CASE WHEN ccso.HGN_DESC = 'Undergraduate' THEN 1 END) AS undergraduate_subjects FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.total_units, sc.undergraduate_subjects, sc.total_subjects FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SubjectCounts sc ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = sc.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WHERE sc.undergraduate_subjects > 0.6 * sc.total_subjects;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev, max_subj.SUBJECT_TITLE AS highest_enrolled_subject, max_subj.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS highest_enrollment FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ) max_subj ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = max_subj.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, max_subj.SUBJECT_TITLE, max_subj.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) , dept_avg_units AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) , top5_depts AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM dept_avg_units ORDER BY avg_total_units DESC LIMIT 5 ) , dept_stats AS ( SELECT ic.DEPT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ( SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPT_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte JOIN top5_depts t5 ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t5.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) ic GROUP BY ic.DEPT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) , max_subjects AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ( SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte JOIN top5_depts t5 ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t5.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) ic WHERE ic.rn = 1 ) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.total_units_variance, ds.total_units_stddev, ms.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_with_max_units, ms.TOTAL_UNITS AS max_total_units FROM dept_stats ds JOIN max_subjects ms ON ds.DEPT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ds.total_units_variance DESC;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.TERM_CODE, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT cso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_offered, SUM(cso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS total_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON ata.TERM_CODE = cso.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cso.LECTURE_UNITS >= 3 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.TERM_CODE, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION ) SELECT icte.TERM_CODE, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.num_subjects_offered, icte.total_lecture_units, t1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS Top_Instructor, t1.Subject_Count FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ata.TERM_CODE, cso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT cso.SUBJECT_ID) AS Subject_Count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON ata.TERM_CODE = cso.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cso.LECTURE_UNITS >= 3 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND cso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ata.TERM_CODE, cso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME ) t1 ON icte.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE AND t1.Subject_Count = ( SELECT MAX(t2.Subject_Count) FROM ( SELECT ata2.TERM_CODE, cso2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT cso2.SUBJECT_ID) AS Subject_Count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso2 ON ata2.TERM_CODE = cso2.TERM_CODE WHERE ata2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND cso2.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cso2.LECTURE_UNITS >= 3 AND cso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND cso2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ata2.TERM_CODE, cso2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME ) t2 WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE ) ORDER BY icte.TERM_CODE;

question: For each academic year, what is the total number of lecture units for all subjects offered in regular terms by the Mathematics department (Course 18), and how does this total compare to the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all years? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS total_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at_all JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON at_all.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.total_lecture_units, stats.avg_lecture_units, stats.stddev_lecture_units, CASE WHEN inner_cte.total_lecture_units >= stats.avg_lecture_units + stats.stddev_lecture_units THEN 'HIGH_PERFORMER' WHEN inner_cte.total_lecture_units <= stats.avg_lecture_units - stats.stddev_lecture_units THEN 'LOW_PERFORMER' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS performance_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(total_lecture_units) AS avg_lecture_units, STDDEV(total_lecture_units) AS stddev_lecture_units FROM inner_cte ) stats;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term_code) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, school_sort) = term_code THEN NULL ELSE term_code END AS term_code, school, avg_enrollment, enrollment_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME END AS school, CASE WHEN GROUPING(OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME END AS school_sort, TERM_CODE AS term_code, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_CODE, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY term_sort, school_sort;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' ) , dept_stats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) , subject_ranks AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.TOTAL_UNITS DESC, ic.SUBJECT_CODE) AS rn FROM inner_cte ic ) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.avg_total_units, ds.total_units_variance, ds.total_units_stddev, sr.SUBJECT_CODE AS top_subject_code, sr.SUBJECT_TITLE AS top_subject_title, sr.TOTAL_UNITS AS top_subject_total_units FROM dept_stats ds LEFT JOIN subject_ranks sr ON ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sr.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND sr.rn = 1 ORDER BY ds.avg_total_units DESC LIMIT 5;

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year, the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in Mathematics (Course 18) courses that are offered in the current term, have more than zero enrolled students, and have available course materials. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.enrolled_range, inner_cte.enrolled_variance, CASE WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_range > inner_cte.enrolled_variance * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_SPREAD' WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_range < inner_cte.enrolled_variance * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_SPREAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE_SPREAD' END AS spread_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.enrolled_range DESC;

question: For each department offering a course, what is the department name, the geometric mean of the total units for courses that have at least one enrolled student, a non-null ISBN in their course materials, and are offered by either the Chemistry or Biology department, and whether the geometric mean is at least 10% higher than the overall average geometric mean (label as 'HIGH_GEOMEAN'), at least 10% lower (label as 'LOW_GEOMEAN'), or otherwise 'AVERAGE'? sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.ISBN IS NOT NULL AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units, overall.avg_geomean, CASE WHEN inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units > overall.avg_geomean * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_GEOMEAN' WHEN inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units < overall.avg_geomean * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_GEOMEAN' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS geomean_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_total_units) AS avg_geomean FROM inner_cte ) overall ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units DESC;
sub_questions: ["For each department offering a course, what is the department name and the geometric mean of the total units for courses that have at least one enrolled student, a non-null ISBN in their course materials, and are offered by either the Chemistry or Biology department?"]
sub_sqls: ["SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.ISBN IS NOT NULL AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC;"]

question: For each academic year, what is the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses, considering only courses that are offered in the fall term, have more than zero enrolled students, and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18)? sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, STDDEV(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled, (MAX(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - AVG(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS)) AS max_minus_avg FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY max_minus_avg DESC;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t0.TERM_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' ) , dept_avg AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, TERM_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE, TERM_CODE ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < d.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND i.TERM_CODE = d.TERM_CODE;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, inner_cte.enrolled_students_stddev, CASE WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance > avg_stats.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance < avg_stats.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(enrolled_students_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte ) avg_stats ORDER BY inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance DESC;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_stddev, CASE WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrollment > overall.avg_all_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrollment < overall.avg_all_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(avg_enrollment) AS avg_all_enrollment FROM ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dept_avgs ) overall ORDER BY inner_cte.enrollment_stddev DESC;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.avg_total_units, icte.stddev_total_units, CASE WHEN icte.avg_total_units > overall.overall_avg * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_LOAD' WHEN icte.avg_total_units < overall.overall_avg * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_LOAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS load_category FROM inner_cte icte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(avg_total_units) AS overall_avg FROM ( SELECT AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) sub ) overall ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2022%' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: ["For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Physics department (Course 8)."]
sub_sqls: ["SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;"]

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS total_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY scd.SCHOOL_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(total_courses) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte WHERE total_courses > ( SELECT AVG(dept_course_count) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE) AS dept_course_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION GROUP BY DEPARTMENT ) sub ) GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME;

question: List the academic year, department, number of unique subjects, minimum total units offered, and the earliest term start date for each academic year and department where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 10 and the department is Chemistry, but only include subjects that are offered by either the Chemistry or Biology departments. question: For each academic year, what is the total number of lecture units for all subjects offered in regular terms by the Mathematics department (Course 18), where at least 60% of those subjects are undergraduate-level (HGN_DESC = 'Undergraduate'), considering only those academic years where the total lecture units are more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total lecture units across all academic years? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.HGN_DESC, ccso.LECTURE_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at_all JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON at_all.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), YearlyTotals AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(LECTURE_UNITS) AS total_lecture_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ), YearlyUndergradCounts AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(CASE WHEN HGN_DESC = 'Undergraduate' THEN 1 END) AS undergrad_count, COUNT(*) AS total_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ), FilteredYears AS ( SELECT yt.ACADEMIC_YEAR, yt.total_lecture_units, yuc.undergrad_count, yuc.total_count FROM YearlyTotals yt JOIN YearlyUndergradCounts yuc ON yt.ACADEMIC_YEAR = yuc.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE CASE WHEN yuc.total_count > 0 THEN (1.0 * yuc.undergrad_count / yuc.total_count) ELSE 0 END >= 0.6 ) SELECT fy.ACADEMIC_YEAR, fy.total_lecture_units FROM FilteredYears fy WHERE fy.total_lecture_units > ( SELECT AVG(total_lecture_units) + STDDEV(total_lecture_units) FROM YearlyTotals ) ;
sub_questions: ["For each academic year, what is the total number of lecture units for all subjects offered in terms that are regular terms and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18), considering only those academic years where the total lecture units are more than one standard deviation above the mean total lecture units across all academic years?"]

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.total_units_range, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.total_units_stddev, cso.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_with_max_units, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title_with_max_units, cso.TOTAL_UNITS AS max_total_units FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cso.SUBJECT_ID, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, cso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON at.TERM_CODE = cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) cso ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS = ( SELECT MAX(cso2.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = cso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND cso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_range DESC;

question: For each department that grants degrees (excluding the Biology department), which offers graduate-level courses, what is the average number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department, and which subjects have an enrollment above this departmental average? Please provide the department name, subject title, and the number of enrolled students for these subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' ) , dept_avg AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.avg_enrolled ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC;

question: For each subject where the responsible faculty MIT ID in the library subject offered table is 928034000 or the number of enrolled students in the tip subject offered table is greater than 5, and where the offer department name in the tip subject offered table is either 'Chemistry' or 'Biology', show the subject title from the library subject offered table, the offer department name from the tip subject offered table, the term code from both tables, the number of enrolled students from both tables, the minimum number of enrolled students in the tip subject offered table over each master subject ID group, and the responsible faculty name from the library subject offered table. Do not repeat the master subject ID if it is the same as the previous row. Order the results by master subject ID and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE AS LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, tso.TERM_CODE AS TIP_TERM_CODE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE ( lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = 928034000 OR tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 ) AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) OVER (ORDER BY MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE) = MASTER_SUBJECT_ID THEN NULL ELSE MASTER_SUBJECT_ID END AS MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, TIP_TERM_CODE, LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte ORDER BY MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the total number of enrolled students in courses offered by the department of Engineering or Science (or the Department of Mathematics), and indicate whether the department is a 'LARGE_DEPARTMENT' (if the total enrolled students is at least 50% greater than the average total enrolled students across these departments), a 'SMALL_DEPARTMENT' (if at least 30% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Only include departments that grant degrees. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ( scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') OR scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_enrolled_students, avg_stats.avg_total_enrolled_students AS benchmark, CASE WHEN inner_cte.total_enrolled_students >= avg_stats.avg_total_enrolled_students * 1.5 THEN 'LARGE_DEPARTMENT' WHEN inner_cte.total_enrolled_students <= avg_stats.avg_total_enrolled_students * 0.7 THEN 'SMALL_DEPARTMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS department_size_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(total_enrolled_students) AS avg_total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ) avg_stats;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_units_range, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS num_unique_courses, scd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_units_range, ic.total_units_variance, ic.total_units_stddev, scd.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

sql: WITH StddevTotalUnits AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sos.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 5 ), GeometricMeanEnrollment AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_enrollment DESC ) SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.stddev_total_units, g.geometric_mean_enrollment FROM StddevTotalUnits s JOIN GeometricMeanEnrollment g ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = g.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

sql: WITH MathSubjects AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_dept_budget_code, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_max_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS > 9 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), DeptMaxUnitsSubjects AS ( SELECT dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmu.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dmu.max_total_units, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM dept_max_units dmu JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dmu.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS = dmu.max_total_units AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' ORDER BY dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.SCHOOL_NAME, ms.avg_dept_budget_code, dmus.max_total_units, dmus.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM MathSubjects ms JOIN DeptMaxUnitsSubjects dmus ON ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dmus.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, dmus.SUBJECT_TITLE;

sql: WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptCoeffVar AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 1 ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_variance, dc.coefficient_of_variation, ROUND(des.enrollment_variance / NULLIF(des.avg_enrollment, 0), 2) AS normalized_variance FROM DeptEnrollmentStats des JOIN DeptCoeffVar dc ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY normalized_variance DESC;

sql: WITH TopDepartments AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), MathSubjectCodes AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT td.DEPARTMENT_NAME, td.subject_count, msc.SUBJECT_CODE, msc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, msc.SCHOOL_NAME, msc.window_column FROM TopDepartments td JOIN MathSubjectCodes msc ON td.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY td.subject_count DESC, msc.window_column;

sql: WITH DepartmentUnitsStats AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), MathSubjects2022 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, ms2022.SUBJECT_CODE, ms2022.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms2022.window_column FROM DepartmentUnitsStats dus JOIN MathSubjects2022 ms2022 ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ms2022.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ms2022.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each department that is degree-granting, is not Biology (Course 7) or Chemistry (Course 5), and offered at least one subject in the 2021FA term, list the department name, the department's full name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for letter graded subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, the maximum total units among its offered subjects in 2021FA, and calculate the normalized average-to-maximum-units ratio (average total units in 2022 divided by maximum total units in 2021FA, rounded to two decimals), ordering the results by this ratio in descending order.
sql: WITH DeptUnits2022 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), DeptMaxUnits2021FA AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d1.avg_total_units, d1.range_total_units, d1.var_total_units, d2.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, ROUND(d1.avg_total_units / NULLIF(d2.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, 0), 2) AS normalized_avg_to_max_units_ratio FROM DeptUnits2022 d1 JOIN DeptMaxUnits2021FA d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY normalized_avg_to_max_units_ratio DESC;

sql: WITH DeptUnitsCV AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), MathSubjectStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcv.coefficient_of_variation, mss.SUBJECT_CODE, mss.subject_code_count, mss.min_dept_budget_code FROM DeptUnitsCV dcv LEFT JOIN MathSubjectStats mss ON dcv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mss.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), for each subject grade type where the subject is offered in the current academic year and is letter graded, provide the department name, the grade type, the number of subjects, the minimum total units, and the geometric mean of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students and only for departments that grant degrees). sql: WITH DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE, COUNT(c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE ), DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_enrollment DESC ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.GRADE_TYPE, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units, des.geometric_mean_enrollment FROM DeptSubjectStats dss JOIN DeptEnrollmentStats des ON dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dss.subject_count DESC, des.geometric_mean_enrollment DESC;

sql: WITH EngEECS_Courses AS ( SELECT t2.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t0.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t2.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ), Dept_Subject_Stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ( SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subjects JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY stddev_subject_codes DESC ) SELECT e.COURSE_NUMBER, e.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.window_column, d.avg_subject_codes, d.stddev_subject_codes FROM EngEECS_Courses e JOIN Dept_Subject_Stats d ON e.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY e.COURSE_NUMBER;

sql: WITH MathUnitsStats AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(total_units) + STDDEV(total_units) FROM ( SELECT SUM(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) t ) ), MathUnitsVariance AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT mus.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mus.total_units, muv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, muv.total_units_variance, muv.total_units_stddev FROM MathUnitsStats mus JOIN MathUnitsVariance muv ON mus.ACADEMIC_YEAR = muv.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY mus.total_units DESC, muv.total_units_variance DESC

sql: WITH DepartmentEnrolledStudents AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) >= 100 ORDER BY total_enrolled_students DESC ), EngineeringEECS_Courses AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t0.DEPARTMENT, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.total_enrolled_students, ecc.COURSE, ecc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ecc.SCHOOL_NAME, ecc.window_column FROM DepartmentEnrolledStudents des JOIN EngineeringEECS_Courses ecc ON des.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ecc.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY des.total_enrolled_students DESC, ecc.COURSE;

question: For each department, provide either (a) the offering school name, number of unique subjects, and minimum total units for those subjects if the department is Chemistry or Biology and the course material status is 'RQ', or (b) the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for subjects offered by that department if the department is degree-granting, not Chemistry, and has more than five subjects offered in the 2022 academic year. Also, include a reason for inclusion ('MaterialStats' for the first case and 'UnitsStddev' for the second). List the department name, offering school name, number of unique subjects, minimum total units, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, and reason, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptMaterialStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ), DeptUnitsStddev AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY total_units_stddev DESC ), CombinedDeptStats AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, subject_count, min_total_units, NULL AS total_units_stddev, 'MaterialStats' AS Reason FROM DeptMaterialStats UNION ALL SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS subject_count, NULL AS min_total_units, total_units_stddev, 'UnitsStddev' AS Reason FROM DeptUnitsStddev ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, subject_count, min_total_units, total_units_stddev, Reason FROM CombinedDeptStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), list the department name, the average total units for subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and total units greater than 0, the range of total units, the variance of total units, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for degree-granting departments, and the ratio of average total units to standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units (rounded to two decimal places), considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and total units greater than 0.
sql: WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), DeptUnitsVarianceStddev AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.avg_total_units, d1.total_units_range, d1.total_units_variance, d2.total_units_stddev, ROUND(d1.avg_total_units / NULLIF(d2.total_units_stddev, 0), 2) AS avg_units_to_stddev_ratio FROM DeptUnitsStats d1 JOIN DeptUnitsVarianceStddev d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY avg_units_to_stddev_ratio DESC;

sql: WITH AvgStddevUnits AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ), VarianceUnits AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, a.avg_total_units, a.stddev_total_units, v.total_units_variance FROM AvgStddevUnits a JOIN VarianceUnits v ON a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = v.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = v.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY a.stddev_total_units DESC;

sql: WITH math_subjects_2022 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), math_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC ) SELECT ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.window_column, mes.avg_enrollment, mes.enrollment_stddev FROM math_subjects_2022 ms LEFT JOIN math_enrollment_stats mes ON ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mes.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ms.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: List, for each department, the department name, the average and variance of the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (for departments that grant degrees, excluding Political Science), and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in the subjects it offers (excluding Chemistry), along with the reason for inclusion ('Avg/Var' for average and variance, 'CoeffVar' for coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)). The columns should be: department name, average enrollment, enrollment variance, coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and reason, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ), DeptCoefficientOfVariation AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 1 ), CombinedDeptStats AS ( SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.avg_enrollment, d1.enrollment_variance, NULL AS coefficient_of_variation, 'Avg/Var' AS Reason FROM DeptEnrollmentStats d1 UNION ALL SELECT d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_enrollment, NULL AS enrollment_variance, d2.coefficient_of_variation, 'CoeffVar' AS Reason FROM DeptCoefficientOfVariation d2 ) SELECT * FROM CombinedDeptStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason;

sql: WITH DepartmentCIPStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY cip_code_range DESC ), DepartmentUnitStats AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT cip.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cip.avg_cip_code, cip.cip_code_range, cip.cip_code_variance, unit.avg_total_units, unit.total_units_range, unit.total_units_variance, ROUND(cip.avg_cip_code / NULLIF(unit.avg_total_units, 0), 2) AS avg_cip_to_unit_ratio FROM DepartmentCIPStats cip JOIN DepartmentUnitStats unit ON cip.DEPARTMENT_NAME = unit.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND cip.DEPARTMENT_CODE = unit.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY avg_cip_to_unit_ratio DESC;

sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 OR (sos.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 21)) GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.min_num_enrolled_students, s1.avg_total_units, s2.coefficient_of_variation FROM Subquery1 s1 LEFT JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

sql: WITH school_math_phys_chem AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget, VARIANCE(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Mathematics', 'Physics', 'Chemistry', 'Biology') AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY budget_variance DESC ), school_degree_granting AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code, MAX(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) - MIN(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS range_dept_budget_code, VARIANCE(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS var_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT smpc.SCHOOL_NAME, smpc.avg_budget, smpc.budget_variance, sdg.avg_dept_budget_code, sdg.range_dept_budget_code, sdg.var_dept_budget_code FROM school_math_phys_chem smpc JOIN school_degree_granting sdg ON smpc.SCHOOL_NAME = sdg.SCHOOL_NAME

sql: WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_dept_budget_code, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_max_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS > 9 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), subq2 AS ( SELECT dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmu.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dmu.max_total_units, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM dept_max_units dmu JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dmu.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS = dmu.max_total_units AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' ORDER BY dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.avg_dept_budget_code, s2.max_total_units, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE

sql: WITH SubjectStats AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), DepartmentUnitStats AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT ss.SUBJECT_CODE, ss.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.window_column, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev FROM SubjectStats ss JOIN DepartmentUnitStats dus ON ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ss.SUBJECT_CODE;

sql: WITH AcademicYearStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), TopMathTerms AS ( SELECT ata.TERM_CODE, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON at.TERM_CODE = cso.TERM_CODE WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.TERM_CODE, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3 ) SELECT ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ays.total_units_range, ays.total_units_variance, ays.total_units_stddev, tmt.TERM_CODE, tmt.TERM_DESCRIPTION, tmt.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AS TERM_ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM AcademicYearStats ays JOIN TopMathTerms tmt ON ays.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = tmt.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ays.total_units_range DESC, tmt.TERM_CODE;

question: For each academic year with more than 10 Mathematics subjects that have course materials and a nonzero number of enrolled students, list the academic year, the academic year description, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in Mathematics subjects, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for Mathematics subjects, and the normalized enrollment variation (standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students divided by coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units), ordered by normalized enrollment variation in descending order.
sql: WITH CoefficientOfVariation AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, (STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), EnrolledStddev AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC ) SELECT es.ACADEMIC_YEAR, es.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, es.enrolled_stddev, cv.coefficient_of_variation, ROUND(es.enrolled_stddev / NULLIF(cv.coefficient_of_variation, 0), 2) AS normalized_enrollment_variation FROM EnrolledStddev es JOIN CoefficientOfVariation cv ON es.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = cv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY normalized_enrollment_variation DESC;

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), which is degree granting, what are the department code, department name, the minimum number of enrolled students in TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED, the average total units in SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY (where the number of enrolled students in TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED is at least 0 or the total units in SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY are between 1 and 21), as well as the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students)? sql: WITH min_enrolled_and_avg_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 OR (sos.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 21)) GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ) SELECT meaud.DEPARTMENT_CODE, meaud.DEPARTMENT_NAME, meaud.min_num_enrolled_students, meaud.avg_total_units, es.avg_enrollment, es.enrollment_variance, es.enrollment_stddev FROM min_enrolled_and_avg_units meaud JOIN enrollment_stats es ON meaud.DEPARTMENT_NAME = es.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

sql: WITH TopDepartments AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), MathBudgetStats AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget, MAX(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) - MIN(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_range, VARIANCE(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY budget_range DESC ) SELECT td.DEPARTMENT_NAME, td.subject_count, mbs.avg_budget, mbs.budget_range, mbs.budget_variance FROM TopDepartments td LEFT JOIN MathBudgetStats mbs ON td.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mbs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY td.subject_count DESC;

sql: WITH Sub1 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ), Sub2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY var_course_number_ascii DESC ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column, s2.avg_course_number_ascii, s2.var_course_number_ascii FROM Sub1 s1 JOIN Sub2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE

sql: WITH EnrolledStddev AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC ), UnitsStats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT e.ACADEMIC_YEAR, e.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, e.enrolled_stddev, u.avg_total_units, u.total_units_variance FROM EnrolledStddev e JOIN UnitsStats u ON e.ACADEMIC_YEAR = u.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND e.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = u.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY e.enrolled_stddev DESC, u.total_units_variance DESC;

question: For the Mathematics department, list the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are letter graded, and the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department, considering only courses with more than 0 enrolled students. sql: WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT du.DEPARTMENT_NAME, du.avg_total_units, du.range_total_units, du.var_total_units, de.avg_enrollment, de.enrollment_range, de.enrollment_variance FROM DeptUnitsStats du JOIN DeptEnrollmentStats de ON du.DEPARTMENT_NAME = de.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND du.DEPARTMENT_CODE = de.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY du.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

sql: WITH TotalUnitsAboveStddev AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(total_units) + STDDEV(total_units) FROM ( SELECT SUM(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) t ) ), YearlyUnitsStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.total_units, y.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, y.total_units_variance, y.total_units_stddev FROM TotalUnitsAboveStddev t JOIN YearlyUnitsStats y ON t.ACADEMIC_YEAR = y.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For the top 10 departments by number of subjects offered in the 2022 academic year (excluding the Political Science department and only including departments that grant degrees), and also excluding the Biology department, provide each department's name, the count of subjects offered, and the variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in 2022. sql: WITH DeptUnitsVariance AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), Top10DeptSubjectCount AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT t.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.subject_count, d.total_units_variance FROM Top10DeptSubjectCount t JOIN DeptUnitsVariance d ON t.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each subject code where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, the average department budget code within each school, the maximum total units of any subject offered by that department in 2024, and the subject title for that subject, considering only subjects that are offered this year and have more than 9 total units, ordered by department name and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH math_subjects AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_dept_budget_code, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_max_units AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS > 9 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), dept_subjects_max_units AS ( SELECT dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmu.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dmu.max_total_units, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM dept_max_units dmu JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dmu.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS = dmu.max_total_units AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' ORDER BY dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT m.SUBJECT_CODE, m.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.SCHOOL_NAME, m.avg_dept_budget_code, d.max_total_units, d.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM math_subjects m JOIN dept_subjects_max_units d ON m.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each department that is degree-granting, excluding the Political Science and Chemistry departments, display the department name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022, and the variance of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department during the term '2014FA'. List the results in descending order of the units range. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH units_stats AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE SSC ON SCD.COURSE = SSC.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED LSO ON SSC.COURSE_NUMBER = LSO.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE LSO.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT u.DEPARTMENT_NAME, u.units_range, u.units_variance, e.enrolled_students_variance FROM units_stats u JOIN enrollment_stats e ON u.DEPARTMENT_NAME = e.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY u.units_range DESC;

question: For each of the Chemistry and Biology departments, give the department name, the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in its offered subjects that have at least one associated course material, and the geometric mean of the total units for courses that have at least one enrolled student and a non-null ISBN in their course materials.
