sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT sq1.SUBJECT_CODE, sq1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, sq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sq1.SCHOOL_NAME, sq1.avg_dept_budget_code, sq2.SUBJECT_TITLE, sq2.TOTAL_UNITS, sq2.window_column FROM Subquery1 sq1 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON sq1.SUBJECT_CODE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE AND sq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN Subquery2 sq2 ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sq2.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND sq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND sq1.SCHOOL_NAME = sq2.SCHOOL_NAME ), school_avg_units AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.avg_dept_budget_code, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, CASE WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS > s.avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_LOAD' WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS < s.avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_LOAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE_LOAD' END AS unit_load_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN school_avg_units s ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), provide the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), as well as the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and departments that grant degrees). Additionally, for each subject in the Mathematics department with more than 0 total units, show the subject id, its total units, and the deviation of its total units from the department's average total units (from the first calculation). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.avg_total_units, s1.stddev_total_units, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT sos.SUBJECT_ID, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.avg_total_units, (sos.TOTAL_UNITS - inner_cte.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.total_units_stddev FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN inner_cte ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0;

sub_sqls: ["SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC;", "SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;", "WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.avg_total_units, s1.stddev_total_units, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME;"]

question: For each department, show the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are letter graded (only including departments that are degree-granting and excluding the Biology department), as well as the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department (considering only courses with more than 0 enrolled students, departments whose name is not null, and only including departments whose name is 'Mathematics'). Then, display only those departments where the average total units is greater than the overall average total units across all departments (using the same filters as above). Present the columns in the following order: department name, average total units, range of total units, variance of total units, average enrollment, enrollment range, and enrollment variance. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.range_total_units, dus.var_total_units, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_range, des.enrollment_variance FROM DeptUnitsStats dus JOIN DeptEnrollmentStats des ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' ) ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Political Science and Chemistry) that offers at least two subjects with more than 0 enrolled students, list the department name, the average number of enrolled students in its subjects, the variance of the number of enrolled students, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students, and the normalized variance (variance divided by average, rounded to two decimals), but only include those departments where the average enrollment is greater than the overall average enrollment across all departments. Order the results by normalized variance in descending order.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptCoeffVar AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 1 ) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_variance, dc.coefficient_of_variation, ROUND(des.enrollment_variance / NULLIF(des.avg_enrollment, 0), 2) AS normalized_variance FROM DeptEnrollmentStats des JOIN DeptCoeffVar dc ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_enrollment > ( SELECT AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' ) ORDER BY normalized_variance DESC;

question: For each department that is degree granting, not 'Mathematics' (Course 18), and offers at least one subject with at least one enrolled student and required course materials in either the Chemistry or Biology department, show the department name, the geometric mean of CIP program codes for all courses in that department where the CIP program code is greater than 0, the average total units, the range of total units, the variance of total units, and the maximum number of enrolled students for those subjects. List the department name, geometric mean of CIP program codes, average total units, total units range, total units variance, and maximum enrolled students in that order, ordered by geometric mean of CIP program codes descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH GeometricMeanCIP AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE))) AS geometric_mean_cip FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_cip DESC ), DeptSubjectUnitStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT gmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, gmc.geometric_mean_cip, dsus.avg_total_units, dsus.total_units_range, dsus.total_units_variance FROM GeometricMeanCIP gmc JOIN DeptSubjectUnitStats dsus ON gmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsus.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY gmc.geometric_mean_cip DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.geometric_mean_cip, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_range, inner_cte.total_units_variance, MAX(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.geometric_mean_cip, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_range, inner_cte.total_units_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_cip DESC;

question: For each degree-granting department, what are the department code, department name, the minimum number of enrolled students in TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED, the average total units in SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY (where the number of enrolled students in TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED is at least 0 or the total units in SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY are between 1 and 21), as well as the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 OR (sos.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 21)) GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.min_num_enrolled_students, icte.avg_total_units, es.avg_enrollment, es.enrollment_variance, es.enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) es ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = es.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department, show the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are letter graded (only including departments that are degree-granting and excluding the Biology department), as well as the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department (considering only courses with more than 0 enrolled students, departments whose name is not null, and only including departments whose name is 'Mathematics'). Additionally, for each such department, list the number of unique subject titles offered in 2022 that are letter graded. Present the columns in the following order: department name, average total units, range of total units, variance of total units, average enrollment, enrollment range, enrollment variance, and number of unique subject titles. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_total_units, icte.range_total_units, icte.var_total_units, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_range, des.enrollment_variance, st.num_unique_subject_titles FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) des ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN ( SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS num_unique_subject_titles FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) st ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = st.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.window_column, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS Most_Prominent_Library_Offer_Dept, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS Enrolled_Student_Count FROM inner_cte ic JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = lso.SUBJECT_ID JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS dept_rank FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 ) ranked_lso ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = ranked_lso.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ranked_lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ranked_lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS WHERE ranked_lso.dept_rank = 1 ORDER BY ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_NUMBER LIMIT 10;

question: For each academic year and department, show the academic year, department name, the total number of units for all subjects offered in terms where the term status is 'Previous' (restricted to the Mathematics department and only for those academic year and department combinations where the total number of units is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total units across all such combinations), the total number of enrolled students in courses offered by the department (restricted to departments that grant degrees and to the Department of Mathematics or departments in the School of Engineering or Science, and only where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 20), and the number of unique subject titles offered by the department in those terms. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(total_units) + STDDEV(total_units) FROM ( SELECT SUM(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) t ) ), DeptEnrolledStudents AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ( scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') OR scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 20 ), DeptSubjectTitles AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS num_unique_subject_titles FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units, des.total_enrolled_students, dst.num_unique_subject_titles FROM inner_cte JOIN DeptEnrolledStudents des ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN DeptSubjectTitles dst ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dst.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dst.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCD.DEPARTMENT, AVG(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, MAX(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, VARIANCE(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE SSC ON SCD.COURSE = SSC.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED LSO ON SSC.COURSE_NUMBER = LSO.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCD.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY enrollment_range DESC ), DeptMinEnrollAndUnits AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 OR (sos.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 21)) GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptTopSubject AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_enrollment, icte.enrollment_range, icte.enrollment_variance, dmu.min_num_enrolled_students, dmu.avg_total_units, dts.SUBJECT_TITLE AS top_subject_title, dts.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS top_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN DeptMinEnrollAndUnits dmu ON icte.DEPARTMENT = dmu.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN DeptTopSubject dts ON dts.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = icte.DEPARTMENT AND dts.rn = 1 ORDER BY icte.enrollment_range DESC LIMIT 10;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), subq2 AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE SSC ON SCD.COURSE = SSC.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED LSO ON SSC.COURSE_NUMBER = LSO.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE LSO.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ) SELECT subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.total_units, subq2.enrolled_students_variance FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS total_subject_codes FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance;

question: For each department that is degree-granting (excluding Chemistry) and is the Mathematics department, provide the department name, the average number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department in the 2022FA term that are offered this year, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in those subjects, the total number of units for all subjects in the course catalog that are offered in the fall term and are part of a degree-granting program, and the number of unique subject titles offered by the department in the 2022FA term that are offered this year. Only include departments where the average enrollment is greater than 0. List the department name, average enrollment, enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), total units, and subject count in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_enrollment, icte.enrollment_stddev, mdu.total_units, subj_count.subject_count FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT AS DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) mdu ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mdu.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) subj_count ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = subj_count.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE icte.avg_enrollment > 0 ORDER BY icte.enrollment_stddev DESC;

question: For all departments that either (1) have a total number of subject codes greater than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean across all departments (considering only degree-granting departments and excluding the Biology department), or (2) are the Mathematics department and have the geometric mean of the total units for subjects offered this year with total units greater than zero, and (3) are the Management department and have the arithmetic mean of the total units for subjects offered this year with total units greater than zero, list the department code, department name, total number of subject codes (if applicable), geometric mean of total units (if applicable), arithmetic mean of total units (if applicable), and the reason for inclusion ("HighSubjectCodeCount" for high subject code count, "MathGeometricMean" for the Mathematics department geometric mean, "MgmtArithmeticMean" for the Management department arithmetic mean). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH dept_code_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), stats AS ( SELECT AVG(subject_code_count) AS mean_count, STDDEV(subject_code_count) AS stddev_count FROM dept_code_counts ), DeptCodeCountsFiltered AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.subject_code_count FROM dept_code_counts d CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE d.subject_code_count > s.mean_count + s.stddev_count ), MathGeometricMean AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC ), MgmtArithmeticMean AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS arithmetic_mean_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Management' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Management' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY arithmetic_mean_total_units DESC ), CombinedDepts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.subject_code_count, NULL AS geometric_mean_total_units, NULL AS arithmetic_mean_total_units, 'HighSubjectCodeCount' AS Reason FROM DeptCodeCountsFiltered d UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS DEPARTMENT_CODE, m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS subject_code_count, m.geometric_mean_total_units, NULL AS arithmetic_mean_total_units, 'MathGeometricMean' AS Reason FROM MathGeometricMean m UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS DEPARTMENT_CODE, mg.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS subject_code_count, NULL AS geometric_mean_total_units, mg.arithmetic_mean_total_units, 'MgmtArithmeticMean' AS Reason FROM MgmtArithmeticMean mg ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_code_count, geometric_mean_total_units, arithmetic_mean_total_units, Reason FROM CombinedDepts ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;

question: For each subject offered in the 'Engineering' school with total units greater than 0 and only for subjects in the 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' department, list the subject title, total units, department name, course description, and the dense rank over the offer department code ordered by offer department code. Additionally, for each such subject, provide the average and variance of the ASCII values of the department's subject codes' course numbers, considering only departments that are degree granting and excluding the Mathematics department. For each such subject, also include the full department name and the school name of the department. MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), MathSubjects2022 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_range, d.total_units_variance, m.SUBJECT_CODE, m.SUBJECT_NUMBER, m.window_column FROM DeptStats d JOIN MathSubjects2022 m ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = m.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY m.SUBJECT_CODE;"]

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding the Biology and Chemistry departments), what is the department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in graduate-level subjects offered by that department, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects it offers with more than 0 enrolled students (excluding the Chemistry department), and the total number of unique graduate-level subjects offered by the department? List the department name, enrolled students variance, enrolled students standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and the count of unique graduate-level subjects in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_coefficient_of_variation AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 1 ), grad_subject_count AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS num_grad_subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME NOT IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, inner_cte.enrolled_students_stddev, dept_coefficient_of_variation.coefficient_of_variation, grad_subject_count.num_grad_subjects FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN dept_coefficient_of_variation ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_coefficient_of_variation.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN grad_subject_count ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = grad_subject_count.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance DESC;

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Biology and Chemistry), list the department name, department full name, and the average, range, and variance of the total units for letter graded subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, along with the maximum total units among subjects offered in the 2021FA term. Only include departments that offered at least one subject in 2021FA. The columns should be: department name, department full name, average total units (2022), range of total units (2022), variance of total units (2022), maximum total units (2021FA). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units_2022, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units_2022, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units_2022 FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE NOT IN ('7', '5') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.avg_total_units_2022, icte.range_total_units_2022, icte.var_total_units_2022, d2021fa.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS_2021FA FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS_2021FA FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE NOT IN ('7', '5') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ) d2021fa ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2021fa.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptUnits2021FA AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ), CombinedDeptUnits AS ( SELECT d2022.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d2022.avg_total_units, d2022.range_total_units, d2022.var_total_units, NULL AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, '2022 Letter Graded' AS Reason FROM DeptUnits2022 d2022 UNION ALL SELECT d2021.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d2021.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS range_total_units, NULL AS var_total_units, d2021.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, '2021FA Max Units' AS Reason FROM DeptUnits2021FA d2021 ) SELECT * FROM CombinedDeptUnits ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason;"]

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), what are the department name, average number of enrolled students in offered subjects, variance of enrolled students, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students (considering only degree-granting departments and subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), and whether the average enrollment is a 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 20% greater than the average across all degree-granting departments), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 20% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE'? Also, what is the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (excluding Political Science and considering only degree-granting departments)? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ), all_dept_avg AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS dept_avg_enrollment FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS overall_avg_enrollment FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), DeptUnitVariation AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_enrollment, icte.enrollment_variance, icte.enrollment_stddev, CASE WHEN icte.avg_enrollment > oa.overall_avg_enrollment * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN icte.avg_enrollment < oa.overall_avg_enrollment * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category, duv.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte icte CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa JOIN DeptUnitVariation duv ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.enrolled_students_variance, scs.subject_code_count_variance, scs.subject_code_count_stddev, mfsc.SUBJECT_CODE AS question: For each school, list the school name, the geometric mean of the department budget codes for degree-granting departments in that school excluding the Political Science department (Course 17), the average and variance of the department budget codes for all departments and subject codes associated with that school but only including the departments Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry, and also display the department among these three with the highest average budget code in each school along with its average budget code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH GeometricMeanDeptBudget AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, EXP(AVG(LOG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE))) AS geometric_mean_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME ), AvgAndVarianceBudget AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget, VARIANCE(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Mathematics', 'Physics', 'Chemistry', 'Biology') AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY budget_variance DESC ) SELECT gmd.SCHOOL_NAME, gmd.geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, avb.avg_budget, avb.budget_variance FROM GeometricMeanDeptBudget gmd JOIN AvgAndVarianceBudget avb ON gmd.SCHOOL_NAME = avb.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY gmd.SCHOOL_NAME ), DeptAvgBudget AS ( SELECT d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS dept_avg_budget FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Mathematics', 'Physics', 'Chemistry') AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptRanked AS ( SELECT dab.SCHOOL_NAME, dab.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dab.dept_avg_budget, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dab.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY dab.dept_avg_budget DESC) AS dept_rank FROM DeptAvgBudget dab ) SELECT icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, icte.avg_budget, icte.budget_variance, dr.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS top_department, dr.dept_avg_budget AS top_department_avg_budget FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN DeptRanked dr ON icte.SCHOOL_NAME = dr.SCHOOL_NAME AND dr.dept_rank = 1 ORDER BY icte.SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For each department, list the department name, department code, and the total number of unique subjects offered by that department (from LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED), the maximum and minimum number of enrolled students in those subjects, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students (considering only subjects with at least 5 enrolled students and departments that are degree granting, but excluding the Chemistry department). Additionally, for the Mathematics department, provide the maximum number of enrolled students in TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED and the sum of total units in SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY (where the number of enrolled students in TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED is at least 5 or the total units in SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY are between 6 and 24, and the department is degree granting). Also, indicate the source of each row as either 'DeptSubjectStats' or 'MathDeptStats'. The columns should be: department name, department code, subject count, max enrollment, min enrollment, enrollment stddev, max num enrolled students, sum total units, and source. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCD.DEPARTMENT AS DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT LSO.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MAX(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment, MIN(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrollment, STDDEV(LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE SSC ON SCD.COURSE = SSC.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED LSO ON SSC.COURSE_NUMBER = LSO.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Chemistry' GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCD.DEPARTMENT ), MathDeptStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, NULL AS subject_count, NULL AS max_enrollment, NULL AS min_enrollment, NULL AS enrollment_stddev, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_num_enrolled_students, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS sum_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ( tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 OR (sos.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 6 AND 24) ) GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), CombinedStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.subject_count, d.max_enrollment, d.min_enrollment, d.enrollment_stddev, NULL AS max_num_enrolled_students, NULL AS sum_total_units, 'DeptSubjectStats' AS Source FROM DeptSubjectStats d UNION ALL SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.DEPARTMENT_CODE, m.subject_count, m.max_enrollment, m.min_enrollment, m.enrollment_stddev, m.max_num_enrolled_students, m.sum_total_units, 'MathDeptStats' AS Source FROM MathDeptStats m ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, subject_count, max_enrollment, min_enrollment, enrollment_stddev, max_num_enrolled_students, sum_total_units, Source FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH dept_max_enroll AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_max_subject AS ( SELECT dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dme.max_enrollment, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY FROM dept_max_enroll dme JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = dme.max_enrollment ), eecs_courses AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t0.DEPARTMENT, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT dms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dms.max_enrollment, dms.SUBJECT_TITLE, dms.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY, dms.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ec.COURSE, ec.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ec.SCHOOL_NAME, ec.window_column FROM dept_max_subject dms JOIN eecs_courses ec ON dms.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ec.DEPARTMENT ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.max_enrollment, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, icte.COURSE, icte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.window_column FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON icte.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY = sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.COURSE;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.enrolled_range, icte.enrolled_variance, dme.max_enrollment, sos_max.SUBJECT_TITLE, avg_enroll.avg_enrollment_2021fa FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN ( SELECT sd2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd2 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos2 ON sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd2.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd2.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' AND sos2.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' GROUP BY sd2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dme ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos_max ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos_max.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND sos_max.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sos_max.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = dme.max_enrollment JOIN ( SELECT sd3.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos3.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment_2021fa FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd3 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos3 ON sd3.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos3.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd3.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd3.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd3.DEPARTMENT_CODE NOT IN ('15', '7') AND sos3.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' GROUP BY sd3.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) avg_enroll ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = avg_enroll.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.enrolled_range DESC, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic year and term, what are the academic year, academic year description, term code, term description, and both the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the record counts of TIP materials associated with that term, considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the TIP material status key is not 'NM'? Also, include subtotals for each academic year (the corresponding term code field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all academic years (the corresponding term code field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the academic year if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by academic year and term code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_DESCRIPTION ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY academic_year_sort, term_code_sort) = ACADEMIC_YEAR THEN NULL ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year, academic_year_desc, term_code, term_description, record_count_variance, record_count_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 9999 ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_code_sort, ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, VARIANCE(record_count_variance) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(record_count_stddev) AS record_count_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY academic_year_sort, term_code_sort;

question: For each academic term in the academic year 2020, provide the term code, term description, the number of unique subjects offered, the total number of tip material records associated with that term, and indicate whether the total tip records for the term are 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' (at least 20% greater than the average across all 2020 terms), 'BELOW_AVERAGE' (at least 20% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT t.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_records FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2020 GROUP BY a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION ), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(total_tip_records) AS avg_tip_records FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.TERM_CODE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.subject_count, i.total_tip_records, CASE WHEN i.total_tip_records > a.avg_tip_records * 1.2 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.total_tip_records < a.avg_tip_records * 0.8 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS tip_record_status FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_cte a;

question: For each department and school, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects, considering only degree-granting departments and subjects with more than 0 enrolled students? Also, include subtotals for each school (the corresponding school field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all schools (the corresponding school field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the school name if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by school and department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(school_name) OVER (ORDER BY school_sort, dept_sort) = school_name THEN NULL ELSE school_name END AS school_name, dept, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, enrollment_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(school_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(dept) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE school_name END AS school_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(school_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(dept) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(school_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(dept) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE school_name END AS school_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(school_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(dept) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE dept END AS dept_sort, dept, AVG(avg_enrollment) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(enrollment_variance) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(enrollment_stddev) AS enrollment_stddev FROM ( SELECT school_name, department_name AS dept, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte ) base GROUP BY school_name, dept WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY school_sort, dept_sort;

question: For each academic year, what is the description of the academic year, the department name, the average total units for all subjects offered by that department in terms that match that academic year and have a term status indicator of 'P', and the deviation of each department's average total units from the overall average total units for that academic year? sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_avg_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.dept_avg_total_units, (inner_cte.dept_avg_total_units - overall.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(dept_avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units FROM ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_avg_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dept_avgs GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) overall ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = overall.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, deviation_from_overall_avg DESC;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ) , dept_stats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) , overall_stats AS ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS overall_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.total_units_range, ds.total_units_variance, ds.total_units_stddev, ds.avg_total_units, CASE WHEN ds.avg_total_units > os.overall_avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN ds.avg_total_units < os.overall_avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'WITHIN_10_PERCENT' END AS avg_total_units_category FROM dept_stats ds CROSS JOIN overall_stats os ORDER BY ds.total_units_range DESC;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, subj_count.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE, COUNT(DISTINCT sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Subjects FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE ) AS subj_count ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subj_count.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND inner_cte.COURSE = subj_count.COURSE ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ), subject_code_avg AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < a.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN subject_code_avg a ON i.SUBJECT_CODE = a.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY i.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each subject that has at least one enrolled student, show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the term code from the library subject offered table, the tip material status key, the total units from the subject offered summary, and the average number of enrolled students within each subject title group ordered by total units. Additionally, for each subject title, include a grand total of enrolled students across all terms in the format of (subject title, null, null, null, null, total enrolled students). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ) SELECT rr.SUBJECT_TITLE, rr.TERM_CODE, rr.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, rr.TOTAL_UNITS, rr.total_enrolled_students FROM RollupResults rr ORDER BY rr.SUBJECT_TITLE, rr.TERM_CODE

question: For each department, among subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are degree granting, provide the department name, the number of subjects offered, and the average, range, and variance of the total units for those subjects, but only include departments that offered at least 5 such subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count, AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY subject_count DESC, total_units_range DESC;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and at least 1 enrolled student), and classify the department as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' if its standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is at least 20% greater than the average, 'LOW_VARIANCE' if its standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is at least 20% less than the average, or 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, CASE WHEN inner_cte.stddev_total_units > inner_cte.avg_total_units * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte.stddev_total_units < inner_cte.avg_total_units * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.stddev_total_units DESC;

question: For each grade type and department in the School of Engineering, list the grade type, department name, the number of subjects with at least 6 units, the average total units for those subjects, the school name, and the department full name. Include subtotals for each grade type (the corresponding grade type field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all grade types (the corresponding grade type field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the grade type if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by grade type and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.GRADE_TYPE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(grade_type) OVER (ORDER BY grade_type_sort, grade_type, dept_sort) = grade_type THEN NULL ELSE grade_type END AS grade_type, dept, subj_count, avg_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(GRADE_TYPE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE GRADE_TYPE END AS grade_type_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(GRADE_TYPE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(GRADE_TYPE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE GRADE_TYPE END AS grade_type, CASE WHEN GROUPING(GRADE_TYPE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept, COUNT(*) AS subj_count, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY GRADE_TYPE, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ) tbltmp LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY grade_type_sort, dept_sort;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_subjects DESC LIMIT 5 ), dept_avg_units AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS overall_avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.num_subjects, dau.avg_total_units, CASE WHEN dau.avg_total_units > oa.overall_avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN dau.avg_total_units < oa.overall_avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_status FROM inner_cte ic JOIN dept_avg_units dau ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dau.DEPARTMENT_CODE CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, CASE WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students > overall.avg_all_enrolled * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students < overall.avg_all_enrolled * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_all_enrolled FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) overall ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_variance DESC;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_units_range, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE total_units_range > (SELECT AVG(total_units_range) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_enrolled_students, sos.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, (inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte;

Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT, i.enrolled_students_variance FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT AVG(enrolled_students_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte ) a ON i.enrolled_students_variance > a.avg_variance ORDER BY i.enrolled_students_variance DESC;

question: For each department, what is the department name and the geometric mean of the total units for subjects offered by that department where the geometric mean is greater than the overall geometric mean of total units for all subjects with total units greater than zero? sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(s.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, geometric_mean_total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE geometric_mean_total_units > ( SELECT EXP(AVG(LN(TOTAL_UNITS))) FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ), YearTermCounts AS ( SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.TERM_CODE) AS num_terms FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(num_terms) AS total_terms FROM YearTermCounts GROUP BY FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(num_terms) > 0 ) SELECT rr.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR, rr.total_terms FROM RollupResults rr ORDER BY rr.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For each department and school, provide the department name, school name, and the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department and school, considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and offered in the 'Engineering' school. Also, include subtotals for each department (the corresponding school field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all departments and schools (the corresponding school field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the department if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by department and school. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(department_name) OVER (ORDER BY dept_sort, school_sort) = department_name THEN NULL ELSE department_name END AS department_name, school, total_units_range, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(department_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(school_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE department_name END AS dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(department_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(school_name) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(department_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(school_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE school_name END AS school_sort, department_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(department_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(school_name) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(department_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(school_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE school_name END AS school, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY department_name, school_name WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY dept_sort, school_sort;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_range, inner_cte.enrolled_variance, CASE WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_range >= 20 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_range < 5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'MEDIUM_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.enrolled_range DESC;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ) , dept_stats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.TOTAL_UNITS, d.avg_total_units, d.stddev_total_units, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - d.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_stats d ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AND i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, deviation_from_avg DESC;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE, SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(inner_cte.total_materials) AS highest_term_materials FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR IN ( SELECT academic_year FROM ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS year_total FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) year_totals WHERE year_total > ( SELECT AVG(total_count) + STDDEV(total_count) FROM ( SELECT SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_count FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) sub ) ) GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(total_units) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.min_enrolled_students, i.total_units, d.avg_total_units, CASE WHEN i.total_units > d.avg_total_units * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_LOAD' WHEN i.total_units < d.avg_total_units * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_LOAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS load_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN dept_avg d;
