question: For each academic year where the total number of materials recorded in TIP_DETAIL is greater than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total number of materials per academic year, give the academic year, the academic year description, the average record count for TIP materials in that year, the range of record counts, the variance of record counts (considering only terms where the term status is not null and the TIP material status is not 'NM'), and the total number of materials recorded in TIP_DETAIL for that academic year. List the results ordered by the range of record counts in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH YearlyRecordStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_record_count, MAX(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS IS NOT NULL AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_range DESC ), HighTotalMaterialYears AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) > ( SELECT AVG(total_count) + STDDEV(total_count) FROM ( SELECT SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_count FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) sub ) ) SELECT y.ACADEMIC_YEAR, y.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, y.avg_record_count, y.record_count_range, y.record_count_variance, h.total_materials FROM YearlyRecordStats y JOIN HighTotalMaterialYears h ON y.ACADEMIC_YEAR = h.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY y.record_count_range DESC;

question: For each academic year, give the academic year, the academic year description, the average of the total units, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units, and the geometric mean of the total units for subjects offered in terms that are regular terms, where the geometric mean is computed only for subjects with total units greater than zero. Present the results ordered by academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH AvgStddevUnits AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ), GeometricMeanUnits AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC ) SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, a.avg_total_units, a.stddev_total_units, g.geometric_mean_total_units FROM AvgStddevUnits a JOIN GeometricMeanUnits g ON a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = g.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For all subject offerings in the academic term with term code '2017FA', show the subject title, the offer department name, the term description, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title. For each of these, also provide the number of unique library subjects offered and the minimum total units for those subjects, considering only departments and course numbers where the number of enrolled students in the subject summary is greater than 2. Show the subject title, offer department name, term description, window column, subject count, and minimum total units in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH SubjectOfferings2017FA AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.COURSE_NUMBER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ), DeptCourseLibraryStats AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.window_column, d.subject_count, d.min_total_units FROM SubjectOfferings2017FA s JOIN DeptCourseLibraryStats d ON s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND s.COURSE_NUMBER = d.COURSE_NUMBER ORDER BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting, show the course description, department name, the dense rank of each course considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department's budget code, the average of the ASCII values of the department's subject codes' course numbers, and the variance of the ASCII values of the department's subject codes' course numbers. sql: WITH EngineeringCourses AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), DepartmentStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY var_course_number_ascii DESC ) SELECT ec.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ec.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ec.window_column, ds.avg_course_number_ascii, ds.var_course_number_ascii FROM EngineeringCourses ec JOIN DepartmentStats ds ON ec.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

sql: WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), SubjectWindowStats AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s.TOTAL_UNITS, s.window_column, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_range, d.total_units_variance FROM SubjectWindowStats s LEFT JOIN DeptUnitsStats d ON s.join_dept_name = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME

sql: WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), DeptUnitsRegularTermStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.avg_total_units AS avg_total_units_all_subjects, d1.total_units_variance AS total_units_variance_all_subjects, d1.total_units_stddev AS total_units_stddev_all_subjects, d2.avg_total_units AS avg_total_units_regular_terms, d2.total_units_range AS total_units_range_regular_terms, d2.total_units_variance AS total_units_variance_regular_terms FROM DeptUnitsStats d1 JOIN DeptUnitsRegularTermStats d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY d1.total_units_variance DESC, d2.total_units_range DESC;

sql: WITH math_courses AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ), subjects_2014fa AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.TERM_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT mc.COURSE_NUMBER, mc.SUBJECT_TITLE, mc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, mc.TERM_DESCRIPTION, mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mc.window_column AS math_window_column, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subj2014fa_SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.window_column AS subj2014fa_window_column FROM math_courses mc JOIN subjects_2014fa s2 ON mc.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND mc.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE

question: For each department that grants degrees, what is the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in the graduate-level subjects offered by that department, as well as the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department with a non-null subject code description? Please provide the department name, the range of enrolled students, the variance of enrolled students (graduate-level), the variance of enrolled students (with non-null subject code description), and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students (with non-null subject code description), in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH dept_enroll_stats_grad AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), dept_enroll_stats_desc AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT g.DEPARTMENT_NAME, g.enrolled_range, g.enrolled_variance, d.enrolled_students_variance, d.enrolled_students_stddev FROM dept_enroll_stats_grad g JOIN dept_enroll_stats_desc d ON g.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY g.enrolled_range DESC;

sql: WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ), subq2 AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s2.subject_count, s2.min_total_units FROM subq1 s1 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE JOIN subq2 s2 ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_ID

sql: WITH DeptUnitsStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ), YearDeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_start_date FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT yds.ACADEMIC_YEAR, yds.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, yds.subject_count, yds.min_start_date, dus.avg_total_units, dus.stddev_total_units FROM YearDeptSubjectStats yds JOIN DeptUnitsStats dus ON yds.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic year and department name where the number of enrolled students is greater than 5, what is the description of the academic year, the variance of the total units for all subjects offered in terms that match that academic year and have a term status indicator of 'P', the number of unique subjects offered, and the minimum start date of the academic term? Display the academic year, academic year description, variance of total units, department name, subject count, and minimum start date, ordered by variance of total units descending and then subject count descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH units_variance AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), subject_counts AS ( SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_start_date FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT u.ACADEMIC_YEAR, u.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, u.total_units_variance, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.subject_count, s.min_start_date FROM units_variance u JOIN subject_counts s ON u.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY u.total_units_variance DESC, s.subject_count DESC;

question: For each subject offered in the Fall term of 2022, show the subject title, department name, term code, academic year, the average academic year within each academic year group ordered by term start date, as well as the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department (considering only departments that grant degrees and courses that are at the graduate level). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH FallSubjects AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.TERM_CODE, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY a.TERM_START_DATE) AS avg_academic_year, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON ata.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE a.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ), DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC ) SELECT fs.SUBJECT_TITLE, fs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, fs.TERM_CODE, fs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, fs.avg_academic_year, des.enrolled_range, des.enrolled_variance FROM FallSubjects fs JOIN DeptEnrollmentStats des ON fs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY fs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, fs.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: List, for subjects offered in the term '2017JA', the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, department full name, subject code, subject code description, the minimum number of enrolled students over each subject code group, and department name, and for each department in the 2022 academic year, the department name, average total units, range of total units, and variance of total units for subjects offered, indicating the source of each row as either '2017JA Subjects' or '2022 Dept Units'. The results should be ordered by department name and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s1.window_column, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS total_units_range, NULL AS total_units_variance, '2017JA Subjects' AS Source FROM Subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE, NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, NULL AS window_column, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.avg_total_units, s2.total_units_range, s2.total_units_variance, '2022 Dept Units' AS Source FROM Subquery2 s2 ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE

question: For each academic year, give the academic year, academic year description, the average, range, and variance of the record counts for TIP materials in that year (considering only terms where the term status is not null and the TIP material status is not 'NM'), and also include the total number of materials recorded in TIP_DETAIL for that academic year if the total number of materials is greater than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total number of materials per academic year. Present the results ordered by the record count range in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH avg_range_variance_per_year AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_record_count, MAX(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS IS NOT NULL AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_range DESC ), total_materials_above_stddev AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) > ( SELECT AVG(total_count) + STDDEV(total_count) FROM ( SELECT SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_count FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) sub ) ) SELECT ar.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ar.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ar.avg_record_count, ar.record_count_range, ar.record_count_variance, tm.total_materials FROM avg_range_variance_per_year ar LEFT JOIN total_materials_above_stddev tm ON ar.ACADEMIC_YEAR = tm.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ar.record_count_range DESC;

sql: WITH SchoolStats AS ( SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION d ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = d.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.COURSE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ), EngineeringCourses AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.avg_total_units, ss.stddev_total_units, ec.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ec.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ec.window_column FROM SchoolStats ss JOIN EngineeringCourses ec ON ss.SCHOOL_NAME = ec.SCHOOL_NAME

question: For each department that is degree-granting and offered at least one subject in the School of Engineering in 2021, provide the department code, department name, department full name, the number of subjects offered, the total number of enrolled students in those subjects, the average number of unique subject codes associated with its courses that are offered by degree-granting departments, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of unique subject codes associated with its courses that are offered by degree-granting departments. List the results ordered by the number of subjects offered in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptEng2021 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ), DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes FROM ( SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subjects JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_subject_codes DESC ) SELECT de.DEPARTMENT_CODE, de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, de.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, de.subject_count, de.total_enrollment, ds.avg_subject_codes, ds.stddev_subject_codes FROM DeptEng2021 de JOIN DeptSubjectStats ds ON de.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY de.subject_count DESC;

question: For each department and academic year where the department's average total units for subjects with more than 0 total units is greater than 6 and the number of unique subjects offered with more than 5 enrolled students is at least 3, provide the department name, the average total units, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, the academic year, the number of unique subjects offered, and the minimum start date of the academic term, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DepartmentUnitsStats AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ), AcademicYearDeptSubjects AS ( SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_start_date FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.stddev_total_units, ayds.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ayds.subject_count, ayds.min_start_date FROM DepartmentUnitsStats dus JOIN AcademicYearDeptSubjects ayds ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ayds.OFFER_DEPT_NAME WHERE dus.avg_total_units > 6 AND ayds.subject_count >= 3 ORDER BY dus.stddev_total_units DESC, ayds.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC;

sql: WITH department_course_summary AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ), department_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC ) SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.SCHOOL_NAME, dcs.course_count, dcs.min_cip_code, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_stddev FROM department_course_summary dcs JOIN department_enrollment_stats des ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

sql: WITH DepartmentCIPStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cip_code_range DESC ), DepartmentEnrolledVariance AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC ) SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.avg_cip_code, dcs.cip_code_range, dcs.cip_code_variance, dev.enrolled_variance FROM DepartmentCIPStats dcs JOIN DepartmentEnrolledVariance dev ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dev.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dcs.cip_code_range DESC, dev.enrolled_variance DESC;

question: For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering with a total of at least 6 units, show the subject code, subject title, department name, the running sum of total units within each grade type, and for the corresponding department also provide the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and offered in the 'Engineering' school), ordered by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.total_units_range, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For all subject offerings in the academic term with term code '2017FA', show the subject title, the offer department name, the term description, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title. For each of these, also provide the material status key, term code, subject ID, ISBN, material key, the course number description, and the maximum number of enrolled students for each row considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by material key, for course material details where the material status key is not null and the number of enrolled students is at least 0. Present the columns in the following order: subject title, offer department name, term description, window column, material status key, term code, subject ID, ISBN, material key, course number description, and maximum number of enrolled students. sql: WITH SubjectOfferings2017FA AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.TERM_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ), CourseMaterialDetail AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.ISBN, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students FROM TIP_DETAIL t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL AND t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.window_column, c.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, c.TERM_CODE, c.SUBJECT_ID, c.ISBN, c.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, c.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, c.max_enrolled_students FROM SubjectOfferings2017FA s JOIN CourseMaterialDetail c ON s.SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID AND s.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY

sql: WITH DeptVariance AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ), DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC ) SELECT dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dv.enrolled_students_variance, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_stddev FROM DeptVariance dv JOIN DeptEnrollmentStats des ON dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, the geometric mean of the total units for all subjects offered in regular terms with total units greater than zero, the range of the number of enrolled students, and the variance of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during terms in that year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students is greater than 0)? Show the academic year, academic year description, geometric mean of total units, enrolled student range, and enrolled student variance, ordered by geometric mean of total units descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH GeometricMeanUnits AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), EnrolledStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gmu.geometric_mean_total_units, es.enrolled_range, es.enrolled_variance FROM GeometricMeanUnits gmu JOIN EnrolledStats es ON gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR = es.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = es.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY gmu.geometric_mean_total_units DESC;

question: For courses in the School of Engineering that are degree granting, show the course description, department name, the dense rank of each course considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the department's budget code, the average of the ASCII values of the department's subject codes' course numbers, and the variance of the ASCII values of the department's subject codes' course numbers. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH EngineeringCourses AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), DepartmentCourseStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY var_course_number_ascii DESC ) SELECT ec.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ec.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ec.window_column, dcs.avg_course_number_ascii, dcs.var_course_number_ascii FROM EngineeringCourses ec JOIN DepartmentCourseStats dcs ON ec.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ec.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ec.window_column

question: For all subject offerings in the academic term with term code '2017FA', show the subject title, the offer department name, the term description, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, and for the corresponding department, provide the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects that are offered this year and are letter graded. List the results ordered by subject title and by variance of total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH SubjectOfferings2017FA AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.COURSE_NUMBER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ), DepartmentUnitsStats AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT so.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, so.TERM_DESCRIPTION, so.window_column, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance FROM SubjectOfferings2017FA so JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON so.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN DepartmentUnitsStats dus ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY so.SUBJECT_TITLE, dus.total_units_variance DESC

sql: WITH DepartmentSubjectStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes FROM ( SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subjects JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY stddev_subject_codes DESC ), Subjects2024_12Units AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.avg_subject_codes, dss.stddev_subject_codes, s24.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s24.SUBJECT_CODE, s24.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s24.SUBJECT_TITLE, s24.TOTAL_UNITS, s24.window_column FROM DepartmentSubjectStats dss JOIN Subjects2024_12Units s24 ON dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s24.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s24.window_column

question: For each department that is degree-granting and offered at least one subject in the School of Engineering in 2021, provide the department code, department name, department full name, the number of subjects offered, the total number of enrolled students in those subjects, the average number of unique subject codes associated with its courses that are offered by degree-granting departments, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of that number. sql: WITH DeptEng2021 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ), DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes FROM ( SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subjects JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_subject_codes DESC ), CombinedDepts AS ( SELECT de.DEPARTMENT_CODE, de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, de.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, de.subject_count, de.total_enrollment, ds.avg_subject_codes, ds.stddev_subject_codes FROM DeptEng2021 de JOIN DeptSubjectStats ds ON de.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM CombinedDepts ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2019FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, show the subject title, offer department name, department full name, number of enrolled students, the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the school code, and for each subject's offer department, also show the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one associated course material. Present the results ordered by the subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), subq2 AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subq1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, subq1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, subq1.window_column, subq2.avg_enrollment, subq2.enrollment_stddev FROM subq1 LEFT JOIN subq2 ON subq1.join_dept_name = subq2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For all subject offerings in the academic term with term code '2017FA', show the subject title, the offer department name, the term description, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title. Additionally, for each matching course material detail, provide the material status key, ISBN, material key, the course number description, and the maximum number of enrolled students for each row considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by material key, where the subject and term code match between the subject offering and the course material. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.TERM_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.ISBN, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students FROM TIP_DETAIL t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL AND t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.ISBN, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s2.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, s2.max_enrolled_students FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE

question: For each department, provide the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of unique subject codes associated with its courses that are offered by degree-granting departments, and for each subject offered in the academic year 2024 with total units equal to 12 in that department, show the subject code, subject number, subject title, total units, and the row number within the department ordered by subject code. The columns should be: department name, average subject codes, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subject codes, subject code, subject number, subject title, total units, and row number within department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes FROM ( SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subjects JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), Subjects2024 AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.avg_subject_codes, dss.stddev_subject_codes, s24.SUBJECT_CODE, s24.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s24.SUBJECT_TITLE, s24.TOTAL_UNITS, s24.window_column FROM DeptSubjectStats dss JOIN Subjects2024 s24 ON dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s24.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s24.window_column

question: For each academic year and department name where the number of enrolled students is greater than 5, what are the academic year, academic year description, geometric mean of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during that year (considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students), department name, number of unique subjects offered, and the minimum start date of the academic term? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH GeometricMeanEnrollment AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_enrollment DESC ), SubjectCountMinStartDate AS ( SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_start_date FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT gme.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gme.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gme.geometric_mean_enrollment, scmsd.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, scmsd.subject_count, scmsd.min_start_date FROM GeometricMeanEnrollment gme JOIN SubjectCountMinStartDate scmsd ON gme.ACADEMIC_YEAR = scmsd.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY gme.geometric_mean_enrollment DESC, scmsd.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

sql: WITH EnrolledSubjects AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_enrolled_students, lso.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), Subjects2016SP AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.SCHOOL_CODE = 'E' ) SELECT es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, es.TERM_CODE, es.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, es.TOTAL_UNITS, es.avg_enrolled_students, s16.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s16.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s16.window_column FROM EnrolledSubjects es JOIN Subjects2016SP s16 ON es.SUBJECT_ID = s16.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.TOTAL_UNITS

question: For each subject offered in the Fall term of 2022, show the subject title, department name, term code, academic year, the average academic year within each academic year group ordered by term start date, as well as the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department (considering only departments that grant degrees and courses that are at the graduate level). sql: WITH Sub1 AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.TERM_CODE, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY a.TERM_START_DATE) AS avg_academic_year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON ata.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE a.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ), Sub2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.avg_academic_year, s2.enrolled_range, s2.enrolled_variance FROM Sub1 s1 LEFT JOIN Sub2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.TERM_CODE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE

sql: WITH DepartmentCourseStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), SubjectEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' ) SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.SCHOOL_NAME, dcs.course_count, dcs.min_cip_code, ses.SUBJECT_TITLE, ses.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ses.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ses.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ses.window_column FROM DepartmentCourseStats dcs JOIN SubjectEnrollmentStats ses ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ses.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ses.SUBJECT_TITLE;

sql: WITH DeptCipStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cip_code_range DESC ), DeptEnrolledVariance AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC ) SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.avg_cip_code, dcs.cip_code_range, dcs.cip_code_variance, dev.enrolled_variance FROM DeptCipStats dcs JOIN DeptEnrolledVariance dev ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dev.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dcs.cip_code_range DESC;

sql: WITH school_stats AS ( SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION d ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = d.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.COURSE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ), engineering_courses AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.avg_total_units, ss.stddev_total_units, ec.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ec.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ec.window_column FROM school_stats ss JOIN engineering_courses ec ON ss.SCHOOL_NAME = ec.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ec.window_column;

sql: WITH MathCourses AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ), Subjects2014FA AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, lso.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT mc.COURSE_NUMBER, mc.SUBJECT_TITLE, mc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, mc.TERM_DESCRIPTION, mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mc.window_column AS math_row_number, s14.SUBJECT_TITLE AS s14_SUBJECT_TITLE, s14.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s14.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s14.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s14.TOTAL_UNITS, s14.window_column AS s14_min_total_units_window, ROUND(mc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS / NULLIF(s14.TOTAL_UNITS, 0), 2) AS Enrolled_Per_Unit FROM MathCourses mc JOIN Subjects2014FA s14 ON mc.SUBJECT_ID = s14.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY Enrolled_Per_Unit DESC;

sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s1.window_column, s2.avg_total_units, s2.total_units_range, s2.total_units_variance, ROUND(s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS / NULLIF(s2.avg_total_units, 0), 2) AS normalized_enrollment_to_units FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_CODE;

sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS unique_materials FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY unique_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.record_count_variance, s2.unique_materials FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY s2.unique_materials DESC;

sql: WITH AvgVarStdPerDept AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), GeomMeanPerDept AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(s.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC ) SELECT a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.avg_total_units, a.total_units_variance, a.total_units_stddev, g.geometric_mean_total_units FROM AvgVarStdPerDept a JOIN GeomMeanPerDept g ON a.DEPARTMENT_NAME = g.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY a.total_units_variance DESC;

sql: WITH DeptEnrolledVariance AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC ), DeptSubjectCounts AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(td.ISBN) AS min_isbn FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT dsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dsc.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, dsc.subject_count, dsc.min_isbn, dev.enrolled_variance FROM DeptSubjectCounts dsc JOIN DeptEnrolledVariance dev ON dsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dev.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dev.enrolled_variance DESC;

sql: WITH GeometricMeanUnits AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), EnrolledStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gmu.geometric_mean_total_units, es.enrolled_range, es.enrolled_variance, ROUND(gmu.geometric_mean_total_units / NULLIF(es.enrolled_range, 0), 2) AS normalized_units_to_range_ratio FROM GeometricMeanUnits gmu JOIN EnrolledStats es ON gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR = es.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = es.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY normalized_units_to_range_ratio DESC;

sql: WITH SubjectCodeRanks AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), DepartmentSubjectCounts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT scr.SUBJECT_CODE, scr.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scr.SCHOOL_NAME, scr.window_column, dsc.subject_code_count, dsc.min_dept_budget_code FROM SubjectCodeRanks scr JOIN DepartmentSubjectCounts dsc ON scr.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND scr.SUBJECT_CODE = dsc.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY scr.SCHOOL_NAME, scr.window_column;

sub_sqls: ["SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'", "SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE;"]

question: For each subject offered in the Fall term of 2022, show the subject title, department name, term code, academic year, the average academic year within each academic year group ordered by term start date, and for the corresponding department, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department considering only courses that have at least one associated TIP material. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH fall_2022_subjects AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.TERM_CODE, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY a.TERM_START_DATE) AS avg_academic_year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON ata.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE a.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ), dept_enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT f22s.SUBJECT_TITLE, f22s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, f22s.TERM_CODE, f22s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, f22s.avg_academic_year, des.num_enrolled_variance, des.num_enrolled_stddev FROM fall_2022_subjects f22s LEFT JOIN dept_enrollment_stats des ON f22s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.department

question: For each academic year and department name where the number of enrolled students is greater than 5, list the academic year, the description of the academic year, the department name, the variance of the total units for all subjects offered in terms that match that academic year and have a term status indicator of 'P', the number of unique subjects offered, the minimum start date of the academic term, and calculate the variance of total units per subject (variance divided by subject count) rounded to two decimal places, ordered by the variance per subject in descending order.
sql: WITH AcademicYearVariance AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), AcademicYearDeptSubjects AS ( SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_start_date FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ayds.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ayv.total_units_variance, ayds.subject_count, ayds.min_start_date, ROUND(ayv.total_units_variance / NULLIF(ayds.subject_count, 0), 2) AS variance_per_subject FROM AcademicYearVariance ayv JOIN AcademicYearDeptSubjects ayds ON ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ayds.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY variance_per_subject DESC;

question: For each department, what are the department name, the average of the total units, the variance of the total units, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units, and the geometric mean of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees and subjects with more than 0 total units? Present the results ordered by the variance of the total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH AvgVarStd AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), GeomMean AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(s.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.avg_total_units, a.total_units_variance, a.total_units_stddev, g.geometric_mean_total_units FROM AvgVarStd a JOIN GeomMean g ON a.DEPARTMENT_NAME = g.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY a.total_units_variance DESC;

question: List all courses offered by the Mathematics department with at least 5 enrolled students, showing the course number, subject title, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, and the row number within each academic year group ordered by course number; and all subjects in the 2014FA term with at least one enrolled student, showing the subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, the TIP material status key, the total number of units, and the minimum total number of units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the course number. sql: WITH MathCourses AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ), Subjects2014FA AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, lso.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), CombinedSubjects AS ( SELECT mc.COURSE_NUMBER, mc.SUBJECT_TITLE, mc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, mc.TERM_DESCRIPTION, mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mc.window_column AS math_window_column, NULL AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NULL AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, NULL AS TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, NULL AS TOTAL_UNITS, NULL AS subj_window_column FROM MathCourses mc UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS COURSE_NUMBER, s2014.SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS math_window_column, s2014.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2014.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s2014.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2014.TOTAL_UNITS, s2014.window_column AS subj_window_column FROM Subjects2014FA s2014 ) SELECT * FROM CombinedSubjects ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE;

sql: WITH EngSubjects AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ), DeptStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), Combined AS ( SELECT e.SUBJECT_CODE, e.SUBJECT_TITLE, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.window_column, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_variance, d.total_units_stddev FROM EngSubjects e JOIN DeptStats d ON e.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column, avg_total_units, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev FROM Combined ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each Mathematics department course with at least 5 enrolled students, show the course number, subject title, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, the row number within each academic year group ordered by course number, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects for that academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH MathCourses AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ), YearlyVariation AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) / NULLIF(AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ) SELECT mc.COURSE_NUMBER, mc.SUBJECT_TITLE, mc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, mc.TERM_DESCRIPTION, mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mc.window_column, yv.coefficient_of_variation FROM MathCourses mc JOIN YearlyVariation yv ON mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = yv.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mc.COURSE_NUMBER;
sub_questions: ["For courses offered by the Mathematics department with at least 5 enrolled students, show the course number, subject title, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, and assign row numbers within each academic year group ordered by course number.", "For each academic year, give the academic year and the coefficient of variation of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects."]

question: For each department that grants degrees and offers graduate-level courses, and for which the number of enrolled students in at least one subject is greater than 2, provide the department name, the range of enrolled students in the subjects offered by that department, the variance of enrolled students, the offering school name, the count of distinct subject IDs with more than 2 enrolled students, and the minimum ISBN value for the associated course materials. List the results ordered by the range of enrolled students in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptEnrolledStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC ), DeptSubjectMaterialStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(td.ISBN) AS min_isbn FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.enrolled_range, d1.enrolled_variance, d2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, d2.subject_count, d2.min_isbn FROM DeptEnrolledStats d1 JOIN DeptSubjectMaterialStats d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY d1.enrolled_range DESC;

question: For each academic year where the total number of materials recorded in TIP_DETAIL is greater than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total number of materials per academic year, show the academic year, academic year description, the average record count for TIP materials in that year (considering only terms where the term status is not null and the TIP material status is not 'NM'), the range of record counts, the variance of record counts, and the total number of materials recorded in TIP_DETAIL for that academic year. List the results in descending order of the total number of materials. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH YearlyTipStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_record_count, MAX(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS IS NOT NULL AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), YearlyTotalMaterials AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) > ( SELECT AVG(total_count) + STDDEV(total_count) FROM ( SELECT SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_count FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) sub ) ) SELECT yts.ACADEMIC_YEAR, yts.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, yts.avg_record_count, yts.record_count_range, yts.record_count_variance, ytm.total_materials FROM YearlyTipStats yts JOIN YearlyTotalMaterials ytm ON yts.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ytm.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ytm.total_materials DESC;
