question: For all subjects in the 2014FA term with at least one enrolled student, show the subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, the TIP material status key, the total number of units, the minimum total number of units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the course number, the corresponding offer school name, and for each subject where the offering department's average total units for subjects offered in the 2022FA term is greater than the overall average total units for that term, also show the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for those subjects. The results are ordered by offering department name and subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, sos.COURSE_NUMBER FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), subq2 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sos.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), filtered_subq2 AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, total_units_range, total_units_variance FROM subq2 WHERE avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(sos2.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos2 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd2 ON sos2.COURSE_NUMBER = scd2.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso2 ON scd2.COURSE = ccso2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sos2.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.window_column, s1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, f2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, f2.avg_total_units, f2.total_units_range, f2.total_units_variance FROM subq1 s1 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON s1.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN filtered_subq2 f2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = f2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each department and each subject offered in 2022 that is also offered by the School of Engineering with at least one required ('RQ') material, provide the department name, the variance of the total units of subjects offered in the 2022 academic year as the benchmark, the subject title, the total units, a classification of 'HIGH_UNIT' if its total units are at least 10% greater than the department's variance, 'LOW_UNIT' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise, the minimum number of enrolled students in any offering of the subject, and the total number of required material records. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.total_units_variance AS department_units_variance, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS, CASE WHEN s.TOTAL_UNITS > d.total_units_variance * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN s.TOTAL_UNITS < d.total_units_variance * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_classification, s.SUBJECT_ID FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = c.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED o ON c.COURSE = o.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN inner_cte d ON c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE o.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, td.RECORD_COUNT FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled, SUM(inner_cte.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_material_records, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.department_units_variance, subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.TOTAL_UNITS, subq1.unit_classification, subq2.min_enrolled, subq2.total_material_records FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE = subq2.SUBJECT_TITLE AND subq1.SUBJECT_ID = subq2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each offering department name and course number description where the number of enrolled students in the library subject offered is greater than 3 and for each corresponding offering school name where the course material status is 'RQ', show the number of distinct ISBNs in TIP_DETAIL, the minimum responsible faculty MIT ID from TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED, the total number of TIP_DETAIL records per offering department name and course number description, the number of unique subjects, the minimum total units for those subjects, and the maximum number of enrolled students for those subjects, listing the columns in the following order: offering department name, course number description, number of distinct ISBNs, minimum responsible faculty MIT ID, total number of TIP_DETAIL records, offering school name, number of unique subjects, minimum total units, and maximum number of enrolled students. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT t.ISBN) AS isbn_count, MIN(ts.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) AS min_faculty_mit_id FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ts ON t.SUBJECT_ID = ts.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC ), subq1 AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, inner_cte1.isbn_count, inner_cte1.min_faculty_mit_id, dept_counts.total_tip_detail_records FROM inner_cte1 JOIN ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, COUNT(t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_tip_detail_records FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC ) AS dept_counts ON inner_cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND inner_cte1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC = dept_counts.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ), subq2 AS ( SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, MAX(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_num_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte2 ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units ) SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, s1.isbn_count, s1.min_faculty_mit_id, s1.total_tip_detail_records, s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s2.subject_count, s2.min_total_units, s2.max_num_enrolled_students FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME;

question: List the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, total number of unique courses, and minimum CIP program code for all subject codes that are associated with departments that are degree-granting and belong to the School of Engineering. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS engineering_degree_granting_subject_codes FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(course_count) AS total_courses, MIN(min_cip_code) AS min_cip_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(course_count) > 0 ) SELECT rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_CODE, rr.total_courses, rr.min_cip_code FROM RollupResults rr ORDER BY rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.total_courses, s2.min_cip_code FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s2.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE

question: For each department and course number where the number of enrolled students in the subject summary is greater than 2, and for all subject offerings in the academic term with term code '2017FA', provide the department name, course number, offering school name, total number of unique library subjects offered, minimum total units for those subjects, subject title, term description, number of enrolled students, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title. Only include rows where the department name matches in both sets. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(subject_count) AS total_subjects, MIN(min_total_units) AS min_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(subject_count) > 0 ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.window_column FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON i.SUBJECT_TITLE = s.SUBJECT_TITLE AND i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND i.TERM_DESCRIPTION = (SELECT TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS WHERE TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE) WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ) SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.COURSE_NUMBER, s1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s1.total_subjects, s1.min_total_units, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.window_column FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.COURSE_NUMBER, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each academic year where the term status is 'Previous', show the financial aid year, the academic year, and the total number of terms in that year, grouped by financial aid year (including a grand total for all terms as (null, null, total terms)). For each such financial aid year, also show for subjects offered in the term '2014FA' the subject title from the library, the number of enrolled students in the library subject, the responsible faculty name from the TIP subject, the offer department name from the TIP subject, and the minimum number of enrolled students in the library subject within a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the TIP subject's responsible faculty MIT ID, but only include results where the number of enrolled students in the library subject is greater than the average number of enrolled students for all library subjects in '2014FA'. The columns should be: financial aid year, academic year, total terms, subject title, number of enrolled students, responsible faculty name, offer department name, and the windowed minimum number of enrolled students. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH RollupResults AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ), YearTermCounts AS ( SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.TERM_CODE) AS num_terms FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ) SELECT FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(num_terms) AS total_terms FROM YearTermCounts GROUP BY FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(num_terms) > 0 ), LibrarySubjectStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, l.TERM_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, window_column, TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte WHERE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > ( SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2014FA' ) ) SELECT rr.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR, rr.total_terms, lss.SUBJECT_TITLE, lss.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lss.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, lss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lss.window_column FROM RollupResults rr LEFT JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON rr.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR = ata.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR LEFT JOIN LibrarySubjectStats lss ON ata.TERM_CODE = lss.TERM_CODE ORDER BY rr.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR, lss.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For the top 10 academic years with the highest geometric mean of total units for all subjects offered in regular terms (with total units greater than zero), display each academic year's description, the geometric mean of total units, the department with the most subjects offered in those terms, the count of subjects from that department, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in offered subjects for that department (considering only degree-granting departments and subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), as well as the total number of subjects offered and the name of the school for that department. The columns should be: academic year description, geometric mean of total units, most represented department, subject count, average enrollment, enrollment variance, enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), total subjects offered, and school name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.geometric_mean_total_units, dmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Represented_Department, dmc.Subject_Count FROM ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dmc JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(Subject_Count) AS Max_Subject_Count FROM ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) sub GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) dmax ON dmc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dmax.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND dmc.Subject_Count = sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), Subquery1 AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_code_count) AS highest_subject_code_count, MIN(min_dept_budget_code) AS min_dept_budget_code, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS Total_Enrolled_Students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' GROUP BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.Total_Enrolled_Students, sc.SUBJECT_CODE AS Most_Frequent_Subject_Code, sc.Subject_Count, ic.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' GROUP BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE ) sc ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sc.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND sc.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.Total_Enrolled_Students DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.highest_subject_code_count, s1.min_dept_budget_code, s2.Total_Enrolled_Students, s2.Most_Frequent_Subject_Code, s2.Subject_Count FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For all subjects in the 2014FA term with at least one enrolled student, show the subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, the TIP material status key, the total number of units, the minimum total number of units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the course number, the corresponding offer school name, and for each, include the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, the description status ('Has Description' or 'No Description'), and the number of subject codes per school name and description status, including a grand total for all subject codes per school name. sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, lso.COURSE_NUMBER FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.COURSE_NUMBER FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), SubjectCodeVisibility AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, CASE WHEN SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND SUBJECT_CODE_DESC <> 'nan' THEN 'Has Description' ELSE 'No Description' END AS description_status FROM inner_cte2 ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, description_status, COUNT(*) AS total_subject_codes FROM SubjectCodeVisibility GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, description_status WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ) SELECT ic1.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ic1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic1.TOTAL_UNITS, ic1.window_column, ic1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, scv.SUBJECT_CODE, scv.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.description_status, rr.total_subject_codes FROM inner_cte1 ic1 LEFT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON ic1.COURSE_NUMBER = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER LEFT JOIN SubjectCodeVisibility scv ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scv.SUBJECT_CODE LEFT JOIN RollupResults rr ON scv.SCHOOL_NAME = rr.SCHOOL_NAME AND scv.description_status = rr.description_status ORDER BY ic1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.description_status;

question: For each academic year and department name where the term status is 'Previous', provide the number of unique subjects offered, the minimum total units for those subjects, the geometric mean of the total units for all subjects offered in regular terms with total units greater than zero for that department, the average total units as a benchmark, and classify the department as 'HIGH_UNIT' if the geometric mean is at least 10% greater than the average, 'LOW_UNIT' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise, but only include those departments where the minimum total units is greater than the overall minimum total units across all such departments and years. List the academic year, department name, subject count, minimum total units, department geometric mean, department average total units, and unit category in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_count, min_total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE min_total_units > ( SELECT MIN(min_total_units) FROM inner_cte ) ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units) AS department_geometric_mean, AVG(inner_cte.avg_total_units) AS department_avg_total_units, CASE WHEN AVG(inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units) > AVG(inner_cte.avg_total_units) * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN AVG(inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units) < AVG(inner_cte.avg_total_units) * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY department_geometric_mean DESC ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.subject_count, s1.min_total_units, s2.department_geometric_mean, s2.department_avg_total_units, s2.unit_category FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_count, min_total_units, department_geometric_mean, department_avg_total_units, unit_category FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each degree-granting department and subject code, list the department name, the subject code, the subject code description, the average and variance of the ASCII values of the course numbers for that subject code, and the maximum average enrollment among all terms for courses offered by that department that have at least one associated TIP material and where the total units for the course are greater than 0. sql: WITH DegreeGrantingDeptStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s.COURSE_NUMBER FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, AVG(ASCII(inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ), DeptMaxAvgEnrollment AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT >= 1 AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sos.TERM_CODE ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(avg_enrollment) AS max_avg_enrollment_per_term FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT dgs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dgs.SUBJECT_CODE, dgs.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, dgs.avg_course_number_ascii, dgs.var_course_number_ascii, dme.max_avg_enrollment_per_term FROM DegreeGrantingDeptStats dgs LEFT JOIN DeptMaxAvgEnrollment dme ON dgs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dme.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dgs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dgs.SUBJECT_CODE;

sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), SubjectCodeVisibility AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, CASE WHEN SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND SUBJECT_CODE_DESC <> 'nan' THEN 'Has Description' ELSE 'No Description' END AS description_status FROM inner_cte1 ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, description_status, COUNT(*) AS total_subject_codes FROM SubjectCodeVisibility GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, description_status WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, l.COURSE_NUMBER, t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' ) SELECT scv.SUBJECT_CODE, scv.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.description_status, rr.total_subject_codes, ic2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ic2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic2.window_column FROM RollupResults rr LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, description_status FROM SubjectCodeVisibility ) scv ON rr.SCHOOL_NAME = scv.SCHOOL_NAME AND rr.description_status = scv.description_status LEFT JOIN inner_cte2 ic2 ON scv.SUBJECT_CODE = ic2.COURSE_NUMBER AND scv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME WHERE ic2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > ( SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2014FA' ) ORDER BY rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.description_status;

sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE AS course_number, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_variance, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, total_units_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' ) ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.avg_total_units, subq1.total_units_variance, subq2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, subq2.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, subq2.window_column FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.total_units_variance DESC, subq2.window_column;

sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), SubjectCodeVisibility AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, CASE WHEN SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND SUBJECT_CODE_DESC <> 'nan' THEN 'Has Description' ELSE 'No Description' END AS description_status FROM inner_cte1 ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, description_status, COUNT(*) AS total_subject_codes FROM SubjectCodeVisibility GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, description_status WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ), SubjectCodeSummary AS ( SELECT scv.SUBJECT_CODE, scv.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.description_status, rr.total_subject_codes FROM RollupResults rr LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, description_status FROM SubjectCodeVisibility ) scv ON rr.SCHOOL_NAME = scv.SCHOOL_NAME AND rr.description_status = scv.description_status ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL ), DepartmentTipStats AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.department, VARIANCE(inner_cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_stddev, COUNT(*) AS total_courses_with_tip_material FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY inner_cte2.department ) SELECT scs.SUBJECT_CODE, scs.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scs.SCHOOL_NAME, scs.description_status, scs.total_subject_codes, dts.num_enrolled_variance, dts.num_enrolled_stddev, dts.total_courses_with_tip_material FROM SubjectCodeSummary scs LEFT JOIN DepartmentTipStats dts ON scs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dts.department ORDER BY scs.SCHOOL_NAME, scs.description_status;

sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCD.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCD.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, units_range, units_variance FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, units_range, units_variance FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(units_range) AS units_range, VARIANCE(units_range) AS units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ) t ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, at2.TERM_START_DATE FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 ON td.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at2.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_lecture_units, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, COUNT(ccs2.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs2 ON ccs2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ccs2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_lecture_units, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE ) SELECT s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.units_range, s1.units_variance, s2.max_lecture_units, s2.TERM_START_DATE, s2.num_subjects_offered FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME

sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.TOTAL_UNITS, d.avg_total_units, d.stddev_total_units, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - d.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_stats d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, CASE WHEN inner_cte.stddev_total_units > inner_cte.avg_total_units * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte.stddev_total_units < inner_cte.avg_total_units * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.avg_total_units, s1.stddev_total_units, s1.deviation_from_avg, s2.variance_category FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.stddev_total_units DESC, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_ID;

sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_enrolled_students, lso.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students, SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS, SUBJECT_ID WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ), GeometricMeanUnits AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE, EXP(AVG(LN(inner_cte2.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT rr.SUBJECT_TITLE, rr.TERM_CODE, rr.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, rr.TOTAL_UNITS, rr.total_enrolled_students, gmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, gmu.geometric_mean_total_units FROM RollupResults rr JOIN GeometricMeanUnits gmu ON rr.SUBJECT_TITLE = gmu.SUBJECT_TITLE AND rr.SUBJECT_ID = gmu.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY gmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SUBJECT_TITLE, rr.TERM_CODE

SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s1.subject_count, s1.min_total_units, s1.avg_num_enrolled_students, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.avg_total_units, s2.stddev_total_units sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > 12 ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students, TERM_CODE, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.max_enrolled_students, s2.TERM_CODE, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.TOTAL_UNITS FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_CODE;

sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(window_column) AS highest_min_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, enrolled_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE enrolled_variance > (SELECT AVG(enrolled_variance) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.highest_min_total_units, s2.enrolled_variance FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.highest_min_total_units DESC

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year, the academic year description, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the record counts of TIP materials associated with that academic year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the TIP material status key is not 'NM'), whether the variance is above or below the average variance across all academic years, and the highest total units of any subject offered in each academic year for terms that are regular terms? List the results in order of decreasing variance. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH record_count_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, inner_cte.record_count_stddev, CASE WHEN inner_cte.record_count_variance > (SELECT AVG(record_count_variance) FROM inner_cte) THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN inner_cte.record_count_variance < (SELECT AVG(record_count_variance) FROM inner_cte) THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.record_count_variance DESC ), highest_units AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS highest_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY highest_total_units DESC ) SELECT rcs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, rcs.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, rcs.record_count_variance, rcs.record_count_stddev, rcs.variance_category, hu.highest_total_units FROM record_count_stats rcs JOIN highest_units hu ON rcs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = hu.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND rcs.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = hu.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY rcs.record_count_variance DESC;

question: For each department where the average total units for subjects offered is greater than the overall average total units across all subjects, and for each course number description in that department where the number of enrolled students in the library subject offered is greater than 3, provide the department name, the average total units, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, the course number description, the number of distinct ISBNs in TIP_DETAIL, the minimum responsible faculty MIT ID from TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED, and the total number of TIP_DETAIL records per offering department name and course number description, ordered by the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT t.ISBN) AS isbn_count, MIN(ts.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) AS min_faculty_mit_id FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ts ON t.SUBJECT_ID = ts.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC ), dept_counts AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, COUNT(t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_tip_detail_records FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC ) SELECT ic1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic1.avg_total_units, ic1.stddev_total_units, ic2.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, ic2.isbn_count, ic2.min_faculty_mit_id, dc.total_tip_detail_records FROM inner_cte1 ic1 JOIN inner_cte2 ic2 ON ic1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN dept_counts dc ON ic2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ic2.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC = dc.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC WHERE ic1.avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) ORDER BY ic1.stddev_total_units DESC;

question: For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering with a total of at least 6 units, show the subject code, subject title, department name, and the running sum of total units within each grade type (only including those subjects where the running sum exceeds 12 units within their grade type), along with the highest number of lecture units among subjects offered by that department in the Fall term of 2022, the start date of that term, and the total number of subjects offered by that department in that term (considering only departments where the highest number of lecture units among their subjects is greater than 3). Order the results by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ), subq1 AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column FROM inner_cte1 WHERE window_column > 12 ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, at2.TERM_START_DATE FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 ON td.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at2.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3 ), subq2 AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.max_lecture_units, inner_cte2.TERM_START_DATE, COUNT(ccs2.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs2 ON ccs2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ccs2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.max_lecture_units, inner_cte2.TERM_START_DATE ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.max_lecture_units, s2.TERM_START_DATE, s2.num_subjects_offered FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For the top 10 subjects offered in the term '2014FA' with the highest number of enrolled students (according to the library subject data), display each subject's title from the library, the number of enrolled students in the library subject, the responsible faculty name and offer department name from the TIP subject, the minimum number of enrolled students in the library subject within a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the TIP subject's responsible faculty MIT ID, and the highest standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students that the offer department has ever had in any term (considering only courses that have at least 5 different materials assigned in that term). Present the results in the order of number of enrolled students descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH TopSubjects AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC LIMIT 10 ), DeptStddev AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.TERM_CODE, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.TERM_CODE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) >= 5 ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(enrolled_stddev) AS highest_enrolled_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY highest_enrolled_stddev DESC ) SELECT ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ts.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ts.window_column, ds.highest_enrolled_stddev FROM TopSubjects ts LEFT JOIN DeptStddev ds ON ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ds.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY ts.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC;

sub_sqls: ["SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA'", "SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2013FA' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) >= 5 ORDER BY enrolled_stddev DESC;", "WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC LIMIT 10;", "WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.TERM_CODE, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.TERM_CODE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) >= 5 ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(enrolled_stddev) AS highest_enrolled_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY highest_enrolled_stddev DESC;"]

question: For academic terms where the term status is 'Previous', show the term code from ACADEMIC_TERMS, the term description from ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL, the academic year from ACADEMIC_TERMS, the running sum of academic years within each financial aid year group, the total number of such terms per financial aid year, the financial aid year, and the number of regular academic terms for each academic year (including null and grand total if available), ordered by academic year. sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ), subq1 AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.TERM_CODE, inner_cte1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte1.window_column, term_counts.Total_Terms, inner_cte1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR FROM inner_cte1 JOIN ( SELECT t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS Total_Terms FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ) term_counts ON inner_cte1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR = term_counts.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON at.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = ata.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ), subq2 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS total_terms FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.window_column, s1.Total_Terms, s1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, s2.total_terms AS regular_term_count FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For each subject offered in the term 2019FA, provide the subject ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, department name, department full name, the department's average enrollment, and whether the number of enrolled students is 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% greater than the average for that department), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than the average for that department), or 'AVERAGE'. Additionally, for each subject's department, also provide the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, and the number of unique subject titles offered by that department in 2022. List the results ordered by department name and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.total_units_range, i.total_units_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS num_unique_subject_titles FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.total_units_range, i.total_units_variance ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.avg_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < d.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s2.avg_enrollment, s2.enrollment_category, s1.avg_total_units, s1.total_units_range, s1.total_units_variance, s1.num_unique_subject_titles FROM subq2 s2 JOIN subq1 s1 ON s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_ID;

MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.total_units_range, i.total_units_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS num_unique_subject_titles FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.total_units_range, i.total_units_variance ORDER BY i.total_units_range DESC;", "WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.avg_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < d.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME;"]

question: For each department, academic year, and academic year description, show the geometric mean of the total units for all subjects offered by the department in regular terms with total units greater than zero, and for each such department also show the master subject ID, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in library subjects that have a matching master subject ID in the TIP subject offerings, and the total number of such subjects per department, considering only departments with more than 0 enrolled students in both tables. The columns should be: department name, academic year, academic year description, geometric mean total units, master subject ID, library students variance, library students standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and total subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH geometric_mean_units AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), library_variance_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, VARIANCE(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_variance, STDDEV(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_stddev, Subject_Counts.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) AS Subject_Counts ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = Subject_Counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, Subject_Counts.Total_Subjects ) SELECT gmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gmu.geometric_mean_total_units, lvs.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, lvs.library_students_variance, lvs.library_students_stddev, lvs.Total_Subjects FROM geometric_mean_units gmu JOIN library_variance_stats lvs ON gmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME = lvs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY gmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC, lvs.library_students_variance DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2016SP' with a school code of 'E', show the subject title, department name, course description, the number of enrolled students, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, and the highest average total units for subjects ever offered by the department in a regular academic term. sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS join_department_name FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.SCHOOL_CODE = 'E' ), cte1 AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte1.window_column, inner_cte1.join_department_name FROM inner_cte1 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON inner_cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE = t2.SUBJECT_TITLE AND t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.TERM_CODE, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.TERM_CODE ), cte2 AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(avg_total_units) AS highest_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY highest_avg_total_units DESC ) SELECT cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, cte1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, cte1.window_column, cte2.highest_avg_total_units FROM cte1 LEFT JOIN cte2 ON cte1.join_department_name = cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

sub_sqls: ["SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.SCHOOL_CODE = 'E'", "SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;", "WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.SCHOOL_CODE = 'E' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = t2.SUBJECT_TITLE AND t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP';", "WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.TERM_CODE, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.TERM_CODE ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(avg_total_units) AS highest_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY highest_avg_total_units DESC;"]

question: For each of the top 10 academic years with the highest geometric mean of total units for all subjects offered in regular terms (with total units greater than zero), list the academic year description, the geometric mean of total units, the department with the most subjects offered in those terms, the count of subjects from that department, the average number of enrolled students in offered subjects for that department, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students, the total number of subjects offered by that department, and the name of the school, considering only degree-granting departments and subjects with more than 0 enrolled students. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.geometric_mean_total_units, dmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Represented_Department, dmc.Subject_Count, dmc.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dmc JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(Subject_Count) AS Max_Subject_Count FROM ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) sub GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) dmax ON dmc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dmax.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND dmc.Subject_Count = dmax.Max_Subject_Count JOIN inner_cte ic ON dmc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ic.geometric_mean_total_units DESC LIMIT 10 ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_variance, inner_cte.enrollment_stddev, COUNT(lso.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects_offered, MAX(scd.SCHOOL_NAME) AS school_name FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_enrollment, inner_cte.enrollment_variance, inner_cte.enrollment_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.enrollment_variance DESC ) SELECT subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, subq1.geometric_mean_total_units, subq1.Most_Represented_Department, subq1.Subject_Count, subq2.avg_enrollment, subq2.enrollment_variance, subq2.enrollment_stddev, subq2.total_subjects_offered, subq2.school_name FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.Most_Represented_Department = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.geometric_mean_total_units DESC, subq2.enrollment_variance DESC;

question: For each department where the average total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units) is greater than the overall average total units across all subjects, provide the department name, subject ID, total units, the department's average total units (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and at least 1 enrolled student), the department's standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units (for the same set), and the deviation of each subject's total units from the department's average. List the results ordered by the department's standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units (descending), then department name, then subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_avg_above_overall AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte1 WHERE avg_total_units > ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subject_deviation AS ( SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.TOTAL_UNITS, d.avg_total_units, d.stddev_total_units, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - d.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN dept_stats d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT sdev.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sdev.SUBJECT_ID, sdev.TOTAL_UNITS, sdev.avg_total_units, sdev.stddev_total_units, sdev.deviation_from_avg FROM subject_deviation sdev JOIN dept_avg_above_overall dao ON sdev.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dao.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sdev.stddev_total_units DESC, sdev.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sdev.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each offering department name and school name where the number of enrolled students is greater than 2 and the department grants degrees and has at least one subject with a non-null subject code description, provide the count of distinct subject IDs, the minimum ISBN value for the associated course materials, the total number of course materials per department and school, the highest number of enrolled students in a single subject for that department, and the normalized materials per maximum enrollment (total number of course materials divided by the highest number of enrolled students in a single subject for that department, rounded to two decimal places). List the offering department name, school name, subject count, minimum ISBN, total materials, highest enrolled students, and normalized materials per max enrollment in that order.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(td.ISBN) AS min_isbn FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, i.subject_count, i.min_isbn, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_materials FROM inner_cte i JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, i.subject_count, i.min_isbn ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS highest_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY highest_enrolled_students DESC ) SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s1.subject_count, s1.min_isbn, s1.total_materials, s2.highest_enrolled_students, ROUND(s1.total_materials / NULLIF(s2.highest_enrolled_students, 0), 2) AS normalized_materials_per_max_enrollment FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY normalized_materials_per_max_enrollment DESC;

Please provide the department name, the variance, and the standard deviation.", "For each offering department name and school name where the number of enrolled students is greater than 2, provide the count of distinct subject IDs, the minimum ISBN value for the associated course materials, and the total number of course materials per department and school.", "For each department, what is the highest number of enrolled students in any subject offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees and subjects with a non-null subject code description? Please provide the department name and the highest number of enrolled students in a single subject."]

question: For each department, for each subject offered in the academic year 2024 that has at least one associated course material, list the department name, subject code, subject number, subject title, term code, term description, the highest minimum total units (in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by academic year), the number of enrolled students, the total number of subjects per department with at least one associated course material, the ratio of highest minimum total units to total number of such subjects (rounded), and the ratio of enrolled students to highest minimum total units (rounded).
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(window_column) AS highest_min_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' ) SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, dept_totals.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) dept_totals ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_totals.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dept_totals.Total_Subjects DESC, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.highest_min_total_units, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.Total_Subjects, ROUND(s1.highest_min_total_units / NULLIF(s2.Total_Subjects, 0), 2) AS units_per_subject_with_material, ROUND(s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS / NULLIF(s1.highest_min_total_units, 0), 2) AS enrolled_per_unit FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND s1.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY units_per_subject_with_material DESC, enrolled_per_unit DESC, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE;
