question: For each department, course number, and offering school name where the number of enrolled students in the subject summary is greater than 2, and for all subject offerings in the academic term with term code '2017FA', provide the department name, course number, offering school name, the number of unique library subjects offered, the minimum total units for those subjects, the subject title, the term description, the number of enrolled students, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title. For each department, course number, and offering school name, include a grand total for all subjects in the format of (department, course number, null, total subjects, min total units, ...). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ), SubjectSummaryByDeptCourseSchool AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(subject_count) AS total_subjects, MIN(min_total_units) AS min_total_units FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(subject_count) > 0 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ), SubjectOfferings2017FA AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.window_column FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON i.SUBJECT_TITLE = s.SUBJECT_TITLE AND i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND i.TERM_DESCRIPTION = (SELECT TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS WHERE TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE) WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ) SELECT sbdcs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sbdcs.COURSE_NUMBER, sbdcs.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, sbdcs.total_subjects, sbdcs.min_total_units, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.TERM_DESCRIPTION, so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, so.window_column FROM SubjectSummaryByDeptCourseSchool sbdcs JOIN SubjectOfferings2017FA so ON sbdcs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY sbdcs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sbdcs.COURSE_NUMBER, sbdcs.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, so.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For subjects offered by departments in the School of Engineering with a total of at least 6 units, show the subject code, subject title, department name, and the running sum of total units within each grade type (only including those subjects where the running sum exceeds 12 units within their grade type), and for each such subject that also has at least one enrolled student, show the maximum number of enrolled students, the term code from the library subject offered table, the tip material status key, and the total units from the subject offered summary. Order the results by subject code and then by the maximum number of enrolled students in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 ) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > 12 ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students, TERM_CODE, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.max_enrolled_students, s2.TERM_CODE, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.TOTAL_UNITS FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.max_enrolled_students DESC

Also, provide a grand total for the entire School of Engineering in the format (null, min_enrolled, total_material_records, ...). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled, SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_material_records FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(min_enrolled) AS min_enrolled, SUM(total_material_records) AS total_material_records FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME WITH ROLLUP ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, EXP(AVG(LN(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC ) SELECT s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.min_enrolled, s1.total_material_records, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.geometric_mean_total_units FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.geometric_mean_total_units DESC

sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.TERM_CODE, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY a.TERM_START_DATE) AS avg_academic_year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON ata.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE a.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ), DepartmentRollup1 AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(avg_academic_year) AS total_avg_academic_year FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR WITH ROLLUP HAVING DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL ), cte1_final AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.TERM_CODE, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.avg_academic_year FROM inner_cte1 i UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS TERM_CODE, d.ACADEMIC_YEAR, d.total_avg_academic_year AS avg_academic_year FROM DepartmentRollup1 d ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_subjects DESC LIMIT 5 ), dept_avg_units AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS overall_avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' ), cte2_final AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.num_subjects, dau.avg_total_units, CASE WHEN dau.avg_total_units > oa.overall_avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN dau.avg_total_units < oa.overall_avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_status FROM inner_cte2 ic JOIN dept_avg_units dau ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dau.DEPARTMENT_CODE CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa ) SELECT cte1_final.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte1_final.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1_final.TERM_CODE, cte1_final.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte1_final.avg_academic_year, cte2_final.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cte2_final.num_subjects, cte2_final.avg_total_units, cte2_final.unit_status FROM cte1_final JOIN cte2_final ON cte1_final.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cte2_final.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cte1_final.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1_final.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte1_final.SUBJECT_TITLE

question: For each degree-granting department and subject code, provide the department name, subject code, the number of subject codes, the minimum department budget code, the full department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department (considering only courses that have at least one associated TIP material), and the total number of such courses per department. List the results ordered by department name and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE ), DegreeGrantingDeptSubjects AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte1 ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL ), DeptCourseStats AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.department, VARIANCE(inner_cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_stddev, COUNT(*) AS total_courses_with_tip_material FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY inner_cte2.department ) SELECT dds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dds.SUBJECT_CODE, dds.subject_code_count, dds.min_dept_budget_code, dds.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, dcs.num_enrolled_variance, dcs.num_enrolled_stddev, dcs.total_courses_with_tip_material FROM DegreeGrantingDeptSubjects dds JOIN DeptCourseStats dcs ON dds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcs.department ORDER BY dds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dds.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For all subjects in the 2014FA term with at least one enrolled student, show the subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, the TIP material status key, the total number of units, and the minimum total number of units in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the course number, along with the cluster type description and the HGN code description for each subject. Additionally, for each subject's offering department, show the school name, department name, the total number of unique subject codes, and the minimum department budget code for degree-granting departments, including grand totals for each school where department is null. The columns should be shown in the following order: subject title, offering department name, responsible faculty name, TIP material status key, total number of units, windowed minimum total units, cluster type description, HGN code description, school name, department name, total subject codes, and minimum department budget code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, sos.SUBJECT_ID, lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), cte1 AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte1.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte1.window_column, sos.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, sos.HGN_CODE_DESC, inner_cte1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON inner_cte1.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(subject_code_count) AS total_subject_codes, MIN(min_dept_budget_code) AS min_dept_budget_code, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(subject_code_count) > 0 ), cte2 AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_subject_codes, min_dept_budget_code, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM RollupResults ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cte1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, cte1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, cte1.TOTAL_UNITS, cte1.window_column, cte1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, cte1.HGN_CODE_DESC, cte2.SCHOOL_NAME, cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte2.total_subject_codes, cte2.min_dept_budget_code FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte2.SCHOOL_NAME, cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each academic year where the running sum of academic years within a financial aid year group for previous terms is greater than the average academic year across all previous terms, what is the academic year, the academic year description, the variance of the number of tip detail records for subjects offered in that year (considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term and have at least one associated tip detail record), the number of unique departments represented among those subjects, the term code, the term description, the running sum of academic years within the financial aid year group, and the financial aid year? List the results ordered by the variance of tip detail record counts (descending), financial aid year, and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS unique_departments FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.record_count_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.record_count_variance DESC ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ) SELECT TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, window_column, FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > ( SELECT AVG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS WHERE TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ) ORDER BY FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.record_count_variance, s1.unique_departments, s2.TERM_CODE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.window_column, s2.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.record_count_variance DESC, s2.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2014 AND l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.TERM_CODE, sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units) AS department_geometric_mean, AVG(inner_cte.avg_total_units) AS department_avg_total_units, CASE WHEN AVG(inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units) > AVG(inner_cte.avg_total_units) * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN AVG(inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units) < AVG(inner_cte.avg_total_units) * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS engineering_degree_granting_subject_codes FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, td.RECORD_COUNT FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_CODE, MIN(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students, SUM(RECORD_COUNT) AS total_material_records FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(RECORD_COUNT) > 0 ORDER BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT subq1.SUBJECT_CODE, subq1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.min_enrolled_students, subq2.total_material_records FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = subq2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE subq2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE IS NOT NULL ORDER BY subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.SUBJECT_CODE

question: For each subject offered in the term '2017FA', provide the subject title, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the record counts for all tip materials associated with that subject, the department name, the total number of enrolled students for each subject, and for each matching department, course number, and offering school name (if available), include the number of unique library subjects offered and the minimum total units for those subjects, grouped by the offering school name. The results should be ordered by the range of record counts in descending order, then by subject title, course number, and offering school name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(t.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON s.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ), subq1 AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.record_count_range, i.record_count_variance, i.record_count_stddev, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte1 i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON i.SUBJECT_TITLE = s.SUBJECT_TITLE AND s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ), subq2 AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(subject_count) AS total_subjects, MIN(min_total_units) AS min_total_units FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(subject_count) > 0 ORDER BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.record_count_range, s1.record_count_variance, s1.record_count_stddev, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.COURSE_NUMBER, s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s2.total_subjects, s2.min_total_units FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = lso.SUBJECT_ID LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND lso.COURSE_NUMBER = s2.COURSE_NUMBER AND lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY s1.record_count_range DESC, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.COURSE_NUMBER, s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME

question: For each department in the 'Engineering' school whose average total units of its courses is greater than the average total units of all 'Engineering' school courses, show the department name, the subject code, the subject title, the geometric mean of the total units for subjects offered by that department where the total units are greater than zero, and the average total units of its courses. List the results ordered by department name and then by geometric mean of total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptAvgUnits AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE AS course_number, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM ( SELECT t0.COURSE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ) dept_courses GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) > ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM ( SELECT t0.COURSE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ) all_courses ) ), DeptSubjectGeomMean AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, EXP(AVG(LN(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT dsgm.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsgm.SUBJECT_ID, dsgm.SUBJECT_TITLE, dsgm.geometric_mean_total_units, dau.avg_total_units FROM DeptSubjectGeomMean dsgm JOIN DeptAvgUnits dau ON dsgm.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dau.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dsgm.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsgm.geometric_mean_total_units DESC;

question: For each school and department, list the school name, department name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022 (including a grand total for all departments in each school as a row with department name null), and, for departments that offered subjects in the Fall term of 2022 with the highest number of lecture units greater than 3, also include the highest number of lecture units among its offered subjects, the start date of the term, and the total number of subjects offered by that department in that term. If a department appears in only one of the two sets, include its information with nulls for the missing columns. The columns should be: school name, department name, units range, units variance, max lecture units, term start date, and number of subjects offered. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCD.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCD.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, units_range, units_variance FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, units_range, units_variance FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(units_range) AS units_range, VARIANCE(units_range) AS units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ) t ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, at2.TERM_START_DATE FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 ON td.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at2.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3 ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_lecture_units, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, COUNT(ccs2.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs2 ON ccs2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ccs2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_lecture_units, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT subq1.SCHOOL_NAME, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.units_range, subq1.units_variance, subq2.max_lecture_units, subq2.TERM_START_DATE, subq2.num_subjects_offered FROM subq1 LEFT JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME UNION ALL SELECT subq1.SCHOOL_NAME, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.units_range, subq1.units_variance, subq2.max_lecture_units, subq2.TERM_START_DATE, subq2.num_subjects_offered FROM subq2 LEFT JOIN subq1 ON subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME

sql: WITH RollupResults AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ), YearTermCounts AS ( SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.TERM_CODE) AS num_terms FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ) SELECT FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(num_terms) AS total_terms FROM YearTermCounts GROUP BY FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(num_terms) > 0 ), LibrarySubjects AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, l.TERM_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' ) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, window_column, TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte WHERE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > ( SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2014FA' ) ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT rr.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR, rr.total_terms, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, NULL AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NULL AS window_column FROM RollupResults rr UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS total_terms, ls.SUBJECT_TITLE, ls.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ls.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ls.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ls.window_column FROM LibrarySubjects ls ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUBJECT_TITLE

sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS DESC ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, enrollment_stddev FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_enrollment > ( SELECT AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.avg_enrollment, s2.enrollment_variance, s2.enrollment_stddev FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.TOTAL_UNITS DESC, s2.enrollment_variance DESC;

question: For each department and academic year, show the department name, academic year, academic year description, the geometric mean of the total units for all subjects offered by the department in regular terms with total units greater than zero, and for each master subject ID in that department that has enrolled students in both the library and TIP subject offerings, show the master subject ID, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in the library subjects, and the total number of such subjects per department. sql: WITH geometric_mean_units AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), library_variance AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, VARIANCE(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_variance, STDDEV(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_students_stddev, Subject_Counts.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) AS Subject_Counts ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = Subject_Counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, Subject_Counts.Total_Subjects ) SELECT gmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gmu.geometric_mean_total_units, lv.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, lv.library_students_variance, lv.library_students_stddev, lv.Total_Subjects FROM geometric_mean_units gmu JOIN library_variance lv ON gmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME = lv.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY gmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC, lv.library_students_variance DESC;

question: For Mathematics department courses with at least 5 enrolled students, where the number of enrolled students exceeds the average for Mathematics courses in the same academic year, show the course number, subject title, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, and the row number within each academic year group ordered by course number. For each course, also provide the academic year description, the geometric mean of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during that year (considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students), and classify the year as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' if the geometric mean is at least 10% greater than the average across all years, 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Present the results ordered by academic year and row number. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ), avg_enrollment AS ( SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 GROUP BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), math_courses AS ( SELECT i.COURSE_NUMBER, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.window_column FROM inner_cte1 i JOIN avg_enrollment a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_students ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), enrollment_stats AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte2.geometric_mean_enrollment, CASE WHEN inner_cte2.geometric_mean_enrollment > avg_stats.avg_geometric_mean * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte2.geometric_mean_enrollment < avg_stats.avg_geometric_mean * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte2 CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_enrollment) AS avg_geometric_mean FROM inner_cte2) avg_stats ) SELECT mc.COURSE_NUMBER, mc.SUBJECT_TITLE, mc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, mc.TERM_DESCRIPTION, mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mc.window_column, es.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, es.geometric_mean_enrollment, es.enrollment_category FROM math_courses mc JOIN enrollment_stats es ON mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = es.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mc.window_column;

window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5", "SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_enrollment DESC;", "WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ), avg_enrollment AS ( SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 GROUP BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT i.COURSE_NUMBER, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.window_column FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_enrollment a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_students;", "WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment, CASE WHEN inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment > avg_stats.avg_geometric_mean * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment < avg_stats.avg_geometric_mean * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_enrollment) AS avg_geometric_mean FROM inner_cte ) avg_stats ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment DESC;"]

question: List, in a single table, (1) the academic year, academic year description, variance in the number of tip detail records, most represented department, and count of such subjects from that department for the academic year with the highest variance in the number of tip detail records for subjects offered in the fall term (with at least one associated tip detail record), and (2) for each textbook material in the TIP_DETAIL table with a material status key of 'RQ', the academic year, subject offered key, material key, subject ID, term code, term description, number of textbook materials per academic year, and minimum term code for each academic year, including subtotals for each academic year (the corresponding academic year field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all academic years (the corresponding academic year field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the academic year if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by result type, academic year, and term code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subquery1 AS ( SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t1.record_count_variance, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Represented_Department, t2.Subject_Count FROM (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(record_count_variance) AS record_count_variance FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC LIMIT 1) t1 JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) t2 ON t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND t2.rn = 1 ORDER BY t1.record_count_variance DESC ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_CODE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ), subquery2 AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(academic_year) OVER (ORDER BY academic_year_sort, min_term_code) = academic_year THEN NULL ELSE academic_year END AS academic_year, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, material_count, min_term_code FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS material_count, MIN(TERM_CODE) AS min_term_code FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION WITH ROLLUP ) tbl ORDER BY academic_year_sort, min_term_code ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT 'Highest Variance Year' AS Result_Type, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.record_count_variance, s1.Most_Represented_Department, s1.Subject_Count, NULL AS TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, NULL AS TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS TERM_CODE, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS material_count, NULL AS min_term_code FROM subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT 'Textbook Materials' AS Result_Type, s2.academic_year, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS record_count_variance, NULL AS Most_Represented_Department, NULL AS Subject_Count, s2.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.TERM_CODE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.material_count, s2.min_term_code FROM subquery2 s2 ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY Result_Type, academic_year, min_term_code ;

question: For each department, show the department name, academic year, academic year description, and the geometric mean of the total units for all subjects offered by the department in regular terms with total units greater than zero, and for each subject offered by the department in the 2019FA term, show the subject ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, department full name, the department's average enrollment, and indicate whether the number of enrolled students is 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% greater than the average for that department), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than the average for that department), or 'AVERAGE'. The results are ordered by department name, academic year (descending), and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH geometric_mean_units AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subject_enrollment AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM subject_enrollment GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT gm.DEPARTMENT_NAME, gm.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gm.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gm.geometric_mean_total_units, se.SUBJECT_ID, se.SUBJECT_TITLE, se.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, se.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, da.avg_enrollment, CASE WHEN se.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > da.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN se.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < da.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM geometric_mean_units gm JOIN subject_enrollment se ON gm.DEPARTMENT_NAME = se.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN dept_avg da ON se.DEPARTMENT_NAME = da.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY gm.DEPARTMENT_NAME, gm.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC, se.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each department name and school name in the School of Engineering, where the number of enrolled students in the offered subject is greater than 3, show the number of offered subjects, the minimum number of enrolled students, the subject title with the highest number of enrolled students in that department and school, the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the total number of material records with status 'RQ', and whether the subject is 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than the average enrolled students for Engineering subjects), 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% more than the average), or 'AVERAGE'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS offered_subject_count, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME ), cte1 AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.offered_subject_count, ic.min_enrolled_students, ls.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_with_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte1 ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 ) ls ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ls.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SCHOOL_NAME = ls.SCHOOL_NAME AND ls.rn = 1 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_material_records FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ), avg_enrollment AS ( SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ), cte2 AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.total_material_records, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrolled * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < a.avg_enrolled * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte2 i CROSS JOIN avg_enrollment a ) SELECT c1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c1.SCHOOL_NAME, c1.offered_subject_count, c1.min_enrolled_students, c1.subject_with_max_enrollment, c2.SUBJECT_TITLE, c2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, c2.total_material_records, c2.enrollment_category FROM cte1 c1 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON c1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND c1.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN cte2 c2 ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = c2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ORDER BY c1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c2.SUBJECT_TITLE;

sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ) SELECT TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, window_column, FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > ( SELECT AVG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS WHERE TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ) ORDER BY FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA' ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.window_column FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND at2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA' WHERE at2.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ) SELECT s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS PREV_TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS PREV_ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.window_column AS PREV_RUNNING_SUM, s1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS SUBJECT_TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS SUBJECT_ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.window_column AS SUBJECT_RANK FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.SUBJECT_ID

question: For each subject offered in the term '2017FA', provide the subject title, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the record counts for all tip materials associated with that subject, the department name, the total number of enrolled students for each subject, the course number, the offering school name, the total number of unique library subjects offered, and the minimum total units for those subjects, where the department and course number have more than 2 enrolled students in the subject summary. Present the results ordered by department name, course number, and descending range of record counts. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(t.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, STDDEV(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_stddev FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON s.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE ), subquery1 AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.record_count_range, i.record_count_variance, i.record_count_stddev, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte1 i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON i.SUBJECT_TITLE = s.SUBJECT_TITLE AND s.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ), subquery2 AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(subject_count) AS total_subjects, MIN(min_total_units) AS min_total_units FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(subject_count) > 0 ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.record_count_range, s1.record_count_variance, s1.record_count_stddev, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.COURSE_NUMBER, s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s2.total_subjects, s2.min_total_units FROM subquery1 s1 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' JOIN subquery2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND sos.COURSE_NUMBER = s2.COURSE_NUMBER ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.COURSE_NUMBER, s1.record_count_range DESC;

question: For each academic year where the running sum of academic years within each financial aid year group for previous terms is greater than the average academic year across all previous terms, and for each subject in the term "2010FA" within that academic year where the term is a regular term, list the term code, the previous term description, the previous academic year, the running sum of academic years, the financial aid year, the subject ID, the subject's term description, the material status key, the subject's academic year, the rank of the subject within the academic year group, and the normalized ratio of the running sum to the subject rank rounded (running sum divided by subject rank), ordered by financial aid year, previous academic year, and subject ID.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ) SELECT TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, window_column, FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > ( SELECT AVG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS WHERE TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' ) ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA' ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.window_column FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at2 ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND at2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA' WHERE at2.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ) SELECT s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS PREV_TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS PREV_ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.window_column AS PREV_RUNNING_SUM, s1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS SUBJECT_TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS SUBJECT_ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.window_column AS SUBJECT_RANK, ROUND(s1.window_column / NULLIF(s2.window_column, 0), 2) AS Normalized_RunningSum_to_SubjectRank FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.SUBJECT_ID

question: For each course material detail, provide the material status key, term code, subject ID, ISBN, material key, course number description, subject title, offering department name, the maximum number of enrolled students for each row considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by material key, the average number of enrolled students for the department, the enrollment category (classified as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' if the number of enrolled students is at least 10% greater than the average for the department, 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise), the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and at least 1 enrolled student), and the variance category (classified as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' if the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is at least 20% greater than the average, 'LOW_VARIANCE' if at least 20% less, or 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' otherwise). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_variance AS ( SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, CASE WHEN inner_cte.stddev_total_units > inner_cte.avg_total_units * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte.stddev_total_units < inner_cte.avg_total_units * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.ISBN, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, MAX(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_DETAIL t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL AND t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT i.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, i.TERM_CODE, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.ISBN, i.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, i.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, d.avg_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < d.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dv.avg_total_units, dv.stddev_total_units, dv.variance_category FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN dept_variance dv ON dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each academic year, list the academic year description, course number, subject title, number of enrolled students, term description, and row number within the academic year group (ordered by course number) for Mathematics department courses with at least 5 enrolled students and with more enrolled students than the average for Mathematics courses in that year, along with the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during terms in that year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students is greater than 0), and the variability category ('HIGH_VARIABILITY' if the range is at least 20, 'LOW_VARIABILITY' if less than 5, or 'MEDIUM_VARIABILITY' otherwise). Show the results ordered by academic year and course number. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH MathCourses AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ) SELECT i.COURSE_NUMBER, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.window_column FROM inner_cte i WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > ( SELECT AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = i.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) ), YearStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_range, inner_cte.enrolled_variance, CASE WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_range >= 20 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_range < 5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'MEDIUM_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte ) SELECT m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, y.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, m.COURSE_NUMBER, m.SUBJECT_TITLE, m.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, m.TERM_DESCRIPTION, m.window_column, y.enrolled_range, y.enrolled_variance, y.variability_category FROM MathCourses m JOIN YearStats y ON m.ACADEMIC_YEAR = y.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, m.COURSE_NUMBER;

MIN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY enrolled_range DESC;", "WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ) SELECT i.COURSE_NUMBER, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.window_column FROM inner_cte i WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > ( SELECT AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = i.ACADEMIC_YEAR )", "WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_range, inner_cte.enrolled_variance, CASE WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_range >= 20 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN inner_cte.enrolled_range < 5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'MEDIUM_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.enrolled_range DESC;"]

question: For each degree-granting department and subject code, provide the department name, subject code, the number of subject codes, the minimum department budget code, the full department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department (considering only courses that have at least one associated TIP material), and the total number of such courses per department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE ), subq1 AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte1 ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL ), subq2 AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.department, VARIANCE(inner_cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_variance, STDDEV(inner_cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS num_enrolled_stddev, COUNT(*) AS total_courses_with_tip_material FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY inner_cte2.department ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.subject_code_count, s1.min_dept_budget_code, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s2.num_enrolled_variance, s2.num_enrolled_stddev, s2.total_courses_with_tip_material FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.department;

sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS engineering_degree_granting_subject_codes FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, tso.TERM_CODE, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_DETAIL td JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, tso.TERM_CODE ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_CODE, MAX(enrolled_variance) AS highest_enrolled_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY highest_enrolled_variance DESC ) SELECT subq1.SUBJECT_CODE, subq1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.highest_enrolled_variance FROM subq1 LEFT JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subq2.highest_enrolled_variance DESC

question: For each department name and school name in the School of Engineering, where the number of enrolled students in the offered subject is greater than 3, show the number of offered subjects, the minimum number of enrolled students, the subject title with the highest number of enrolled students in that department and school, the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the total number of material records with status 'RQ', and whether the subject is 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than the average enrolled students for Engineering subjects), 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% more than the average), or 'AVERAGE'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS offered_subject_count, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME ), cte1 AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.offered_subject_count, ic.min_enrolled_students, ls.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_with_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte1 ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 ) ls ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ls.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SCHOOL_NAME = ls.SCHOOL_NAME AND ls.rn = 1 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_material_records FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ), avg_enrollment AS ( SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ), cte2 AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.total_material_records, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrolled * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < a.avg_enrolled * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte2 i CROSS JOIN avg_enrollment a ) SELECT c1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c1.SCHOOL_NAME, c1.offered_subject_count, c1.min_enrolled_students, c1.subject_with_max_enrollment, c2.SUBJECT_TITLE, c2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, c2.total_material_records, c2.enrollment_category FROM cte1 c1 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON c1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND c1.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN cte2 c2 ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = c2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' ORDER BY c1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC;

question: For each academic year and department name where the term status is 'Previous', provide the number of unique subjects offered, the minimum total units for those subjects, the average and variance of the ASCII values of the department's subject codes' course numbers (considering only degree granting departments), and the total number of subject codes for each department, but only include those departments where the minimum total units is greater than the overall minimum total units across all such departments and years. Show the results in the order of academic year and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_count, min_total_units FROM inner_cte WHERE min_total_units > (SELECT MIN(min_total_units) FROM inner_cte) ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS avg_course_number_ascii, VARIANCE(ASCII(s.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS var_course_number_ascii FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_course_number_ascii, i.var_course_number_ascii, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS total_subject_codes FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_course_number_ascii, i.var_course_number_ascii ORDER BY i.var_course_number_ascii DESC ) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.subject_count, s1.min_total_units, s2.avg_course_number_ascii, s2.var_course_number_ascii, s2.total_subject_codes FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each department, provide the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, the number of unique subject titles offered in 2022, and for each subject offered in the term 2019FA in that department, show the subject ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, department full name, the department's average enrollment, and indicate whether the number of enrolled students is 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% greater than the average for that department), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than the average for that department), or 'AVERAGE'. The columns should be: department name, average total units, total units range, total units variance, number of unique subject titles, subject ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, department full name, average enrollment, and enrollment category. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH dept_units_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.total_units_range, i.total_units_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS num_unique_subject_titles FROM inner_cte i JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_total_units, i.total_units_range, i.total_units_variance ), subject_enrollment_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.avg_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < d.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, dus.num_unique_subject_titles, ses.SUBJECT_ID, ses.SUBJECT_TITLE, ses.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ses.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ses.avg_enrollment, ses.enrollment_category FROM dept_units_stats dus JOIN subject_enrollment_stats ses ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ses.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dus.total_units_range DESC, ses.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC;

question: For each course material detail, provide the TIP material status key, term code, subject ID, ISBN, material key, course number description, subject title, offering department name, the maximum number of enrolled students for each row considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by material key, the average number of enrolled students for the department, the enrollment category (classified as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' if the number of enrolled students is at least 10% greater than the average for the department, 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' if at least 10% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise), the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and at least 1 enrolled student), and the variance category for the department (classified as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' if its standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is at least 20% greater than the average, 'LOW_VARIANCE' if at least 20% less, or 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' otherwise). sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_variance AS ( SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, CASE WHEN inner_cte.stddev_total_units > inner_cte.avg_total_units * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte.stddev_total_units < inner_cte.avg_total_units * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.stddev_total_units DESC ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.ISBN, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, MAX(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_DETAIL t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL AND t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT i.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, i.TERM_CODE, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.ISBN, i.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, i.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, d.avg_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < d.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category, dv.avg_total_units, dv.stddev_total_units, dv.variance_category FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN dept_avg d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN dept_variance dv ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
