sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_enrollment, icte.enrollment_variance, icte.enrollment_stddev, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_with_rq_material FROM inner_cte icte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_enrollment, icte.enrollment_variance, icte.enrollment_stddev ORDER BY icte.enrollment_variance DESC;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT >= 1 AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ), DeptSchoolSubjectStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT dss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dss.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_variance, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units FROM DeptSchoolSubjectStats dss LEFT JOIN DeptEnrollmentStats des ON dss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dss.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.avg_enrollment, ic.enrollment_variance, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units FROM inner_cte ic WHERE ic.subject_count >= 5 ORDER BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME;

question: From the top 10 subject codes with the highest number of associated departments (where the department is degree granting), display each subject code, its description, the total number of associated departments, the school name, the department most frequently associated with the subject code, and the minimum department budget code for that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), SubjectDeptCounts AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS dept_count, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SCHOOL_NAME ), DeptFrequency AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS dept_freq, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptRanked AS ( SELECT df.SUBJECT_CODE, df.DEPARTMENT_NAME, df.dept_freq, df.min_dept_budget_code, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY df.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY df.dept_freq DESC) AS dept_rank FROM DeptFrequency df ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, sdc.dept_count AS total_departments, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, dr.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS most_frequent_department, dr.min_dept_budget_code FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SubjectDeptCounts sdc ON ic.SUBJECT_CODE = sdc.SUBJECT_CODE AND ic.SCHOOL_NAME = sdc.SCHOOL_NAME LEFT JOIN DeptRanked dr ON ic.SUBJECT_CODE = dr.SUBJECT_CODE AND dr.dept_rank = 1 ORDER BY sdc.dept_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each department that is degree-granting and offered at least one subject in the School of Engineering in 2021, provide the department code, department name, department full name, the number of subjects offered, the total number of enrolled students in those subjects, the average number of unique subject codes associated with its courses that are offered by degree-granting departments, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of unique subject codes associated with its courses that are offered by degree-granting departments, and whether the department's total enrollment is at least 20% higher than the average total enrollment across all such departments ('HIGH_ENROLLMENT'), at least 20% lower ('LOW_ENROLLMENT'), or otherwise 'AVERAGE_ENROLLMENT'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ), DeptSubjectStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes FROM ( SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT ) course_subjects JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), EnrollmentBenchmarks AS ( SELECT AVG(total_enrollment) AS avg_total_enrollment FROM inner_cte ) SELECT de.DEPARTMENT_CODE, de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, de.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, de.subject_count, de.total_enrollment, ds.avg_subject_codes, ds.stddev_subject_codes, CASE WHEN de.total_enrollment > eb.avg_total_enrollment * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN de.total_enrollment < eb.avg_total_enrollment * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE_ENROLLMENT' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte de JOIN DeptSubjectStats ds ON de.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME CROSS JOIN EnrollmentBenchmarks eb ORDER BY de.subject_count DESC;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DegreeGrantingDeptCourses AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ), DeptEnrolledStudents AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ), CombinedDeptInfo AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.course_count, d.min_cip_code, s.total_enrolled FROM DegreeGrantingDeptCourses d JOIN DeptEnrolledStudents s ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM CombinedDeptInfo ), EngineeringEnrolled AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS engineering_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.course_count, i.min_cip_code, i.total_enrolled, COALESCE(e.engineering_enrolled, 0) AS engineering_enrolled FROM inner_cte i LEFT JOIN EngineeringEnrolled e ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = e.OFFER_DEPT_NAME WHERE COALESCE(e.engineering_enrolled, 0) > 0.6 * i.total_enrolled ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ISBN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS material_status_row_number FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), dept_info AS ( SELECT tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ), school_counts AS ( SELECT di.SCHOOL_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT di.SUBJECT_ID) AS Subject_Count FROM dept_info di GROUP BY di.SCHOOL_CODE ), school_ranked AS ( SELECT sc.SCHOOL_CODE, sc.Subject_Count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sc.Subject_Count DESC) AS school_rank FROM school_counts sc ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.TERM_CODE, ic.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic.ISBN, ic.material_status_row_number, di.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, di.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sr.SCHOOL_CODE AS Most_Represented_School, sr.Subject_Count AS Subjects_From_School FROM inner_cte ic JOIN dept_info di ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = di.SUBJECT_ID JOIN school_ranked sr ON di.SCHOOL_CODE = sr.SCHOOL_CODE AND sr.school_rank = 1 ORDER BY ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC LIMIT 10;
sub_questions: ["For subjects with at least 5 enrolled students, show the subject ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, term code, material status key, ISBN, and assign row numbers within each material status group ordered by subject ID.", "For subjects offered in the term '2019FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, show the subject title, offer department name, department full name, number of enrolled students, and the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the school code, ordered by the subject title.", "For subjects with at least 5 enrolled students that were also offered in the term '2019FA' with more than 0 enrolled students, show the subject ID, subject title, number of enrolled students, term code, material status key, ISBN, the row number within each material status group ordered by subject ID, offer department name, department full name, and the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the school code, ordered by the subject title."]
sub_sqls: ["SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ISBN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5", "SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0", "WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ISBN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 ), subq2 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.ISBN, s1.window_column AS material_status_row_number, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s2.window_column AS avg_enrollment_window FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID"]

question: For each department name and school name, where the department is degree granting and the department has more than 10 total enrolled students in courses offered by both the library and the TIP system in the term '2019FA', provide the number of unique courses, the minimum CIP program code from the course descriptions, the total number of enrolled students, and classify the department as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' if the total enrolled students is at least 20% greater than the average total enrolled students across all such departments, 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' if at least 20% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. List the department name, school name, course count, minimum CIP program code, total enrolled students, and enrollment category in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DegreeGrantingDeptCourses AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ), DeptEnrolledStudents AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ), CombinedDeptInfo AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.course_count, d.min_cip_code, s.total_enrolled FROM DegreeGrantingDeptCourses d JOIN DeptEnrolledStudents s ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM CombinedDeptInfo ), avg_enrollment AS ( SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) AS avg_total_enrolled FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.course_count, i.min_cip_code, i.total_enrolled, CASE WHEN i.total_enrolled > a.avg_total_enrolled * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.total_enrolled < a.avg_total_enrolled * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_enrollment a ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, the geometric mean of the total units for all subjects offered in regular terms with total units greater than zero, the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during terms in that year where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students is greater than 0, and for each department, the department name and the total number of unique subjects offered in regular terms with total units greater than zero? List the academic year, academic year description, geometric mean total units, enrolled range, enrolled variance, normalized units to range ratio, department name, and total subjects per department, ordered by normalized units to range ratio descending and department name ascending.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH GeometricMeanUnits AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ), EnrolledStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gmu.geometric_mean_total_units, es.enrolled_range, es.enrolled_variance, ROUND(gmu.geometric_mean_total_units / NULLIF(es.enrolled_range, 0), 2) AS normalized_units_to_range_ratio FROM GeometricMeanUnits gmu JOIN EnrolledStats es ON gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR = es.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND gmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = es.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units, inner_cte.enrolled_range, inner_cte.enrolled_variance, inner_cte.normalized_units_to_range_ratio, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept_stats.total_subjects_per_department FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE IN ( SELECT TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS WHERE IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ) JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects_per_department FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE IN ( SELECT TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS WHERE IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ) GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dept_stats ON cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dept_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.normalized_units_to_range_ratio DESC, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ASC;

question: For each academic year and term status, where the total number of materials recorded in TIP_DETAIL is greater than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean total number of materials per academic year, list the academic year, academic year description, term status, the average record count for TIP materials in that year and term status, the range of record counts, the variance of record counts (considering only terms where the term status is not null and the TIP material status is not 'NM'), and the total number of materials recorded in TIP_DETAIL for that academic year and term status. Also, for each academic year, include a grand total for all term statuses in the format of (academic year, academic year description, null, ...). List the results ordered by the range of record counts in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS, AVG(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_record_count, MAX(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance, SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_materials FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS IS NOT NULL AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS ), HighTotalMaterialYears AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) > ( SELECT AVG(total_count) + STDDEV(total_count) FROM ( SELECT SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_count FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) sub ) ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TERM_STATUS, AVG(avg_record_count) AS avg_record_count, MAX(record_count_range) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(avg_record_count) AS record_count_variance, SUM(total_materials) AS total_materials FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TERM_STATUS WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_materials) > 0 ) SELECT rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, rr.TERM_STATUS, rr.avg_record_count, rr.record_count_range, rr.record_count_variance, rr.total_materials FROM RollupResults rr JOIN HighTotalMaterialYears h ON rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR = h.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY rr.record_count_range DESC ;

sub_sqls: ["SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_record_count, MAX(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS IS NOT NULL AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_range DESC;", "SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) > ( SELECT AVG(total_count) + STDDEV(total_count) FROM ( SELECT SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_count FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) sub )", "WITH YearlyRecordStats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_record_count, MAX(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) - MIN(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_range, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS IS NOT NULL AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_range DESC ), HighTotalMaterialYears AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) > ( SELECT AVG(total_count) + STDDEV(total_count) FROM ( SELECT SUM(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_count FROM TIP_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) sub ) ) SELECT y.ACADEMIC_YEAR, y.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, y.avg_record_count, y.record_count_range, y.record_count_variance, h.total_materials FROM YearlyRecordStats y JOIN HighTotalMaterialYears h ON y.ACADEMIC_YEAR = h.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY y.record_count_range DESC;"]

question: For each offering department and school where the course material status is 'RQ', provide the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department (considering only courses that have at least one associated TIP material and where the total units for the course are greater than 0), along with the number of unique subjects and the minimum total units for those subjects, and also include the total number of TIP materials for each department and school. List the offering department name, offering school name, average enrollment, enrollment variance, subject count, minimum total units, and total TIP materials in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT >= 1 AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ), DeptSchoolSubjectStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT dss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dss.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_variance, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units FROM DeptSchoolSubjectStats dss LEFT JOIN DeptEnrollmentStats des ON dss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY dss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dss.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, icte.avg_enrollment, icte.enrollment_variance, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, COALESCE(tip_counts.total_tip_materials, 0) AS total_tip_materials FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) tip_counts ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tip_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND icte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = tip_counts.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For each subject offered in the academic term with term code '2006FA', show the subject ID, subject title, department name, the sum of lecture units within each grade type group, the number of unique library subjects offered, the minimum total units for those subjects, and the average number of enrolled students for those subjects, considering only departments and course numbers where the number of enrolled students in the subject summary is greater than 2. Present the results ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA' ), DeptCourseLibraryStats AS ( SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.window_column, dcls.subject_count, dcls.min_total_units, dcls.avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte icte JOIN DeptCourseLibraryStats dcls ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcls.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each subject offered in the Spring term of 2023 and for each subject offered in the academic year 2025 with total units equal to 9, show the subject title, department name, term code, academic year, and the average academic year within each academic year group ordered by term start date from the Spring 2023 subjects, and the department code, department name, subject code, subject number, subject title, total units, and the row number within each department ordered by subject code from the 2025 subjects. Additionally, for each department, include the total number of 2025 subjects with 9 units in the format of (department code, department name, null, null, null, null, total subjects). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.TERM_CODE, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY a.TERM_START_DATE) AS avg_academic_year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON ata.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE a.TERM_CODE = '2023SP' ), subjects_2025_9units AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2025 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 9 ), dept_totals AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE, NULL AS SUBJECT_NUMBER, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS total_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2025 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 9 GROUP BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TERM_CODE, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.avg_academic_year, s25.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s25.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS s25_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s25.SUBJECT_CODE, s25.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s25.SUBJECT_TITLE AS s25_SUBJECT_TITLE, s25.TOTAL_UNITS, s25.window_column FROM inner_cte icte CROSS JOIN subjects_2025_9units s25 UNION ALL SELECT NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, dt.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dt.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dt.SUBJECT_CODE, dt.SUBJECT_NUMBER, dt.SUBJECT_TITLE, dt.total_subjects, NULL FROM dept_totals dt;

question: For each department that grants degrees, which subjects offered by that department have a total units value greater than the average total units for that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units)? sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptSubjectCounts AS ( SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_subjects DESC LIMIT 5 ), SubjectOfferings AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS > 10 ) SELECT dsc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsc.num_subjects, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.window_column, sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM DeptSubjectCounts dsc JOIN SubjectOfferings so ON dsc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = so.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON so.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' ) , RollupResults AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, num_subjects, SUBJECT_TITLE, window_column, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, num_subjects, SUBJECT_TITLE, window_column WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) IS NOT NULL ) SELECT rr.DEPARTMENT_CODE, rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.num_subjects, rr.SUBJECT_TITLE, rr.window_column, rr.total_enrolled_students FROM RollupResults rr ORDER BY rr.DEPARTMENT_CODE, rr.window_column, rr.SUBJECT_TITLE ;

sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance FROM GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC ), DeptSchoolSubjectStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT dss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dss.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_variance, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units FROM DeptSchoolSubjectStats dss LEFT JOIN DeptEnrollmentStats des ON dss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY des.avg_enrollment DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, icte.avg_enrollment, icte.enrollment_variance, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, sos.SUBJECT_ID AS top_subject_id, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE AS top_subject_title, sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS top_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC ) AS rn FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ) sos ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_grad, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_grad, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), dept_enroll_stats_desc AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.max_enrolled_grad, i.min_enrolled_grad, d.avg_enrolled_students, d.total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_enroll_stats_desc d ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY i.max_enrolled_grad DESC;

MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), dept_enroll_stats_desc AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT g.DEPARTMENT_NAME, g.enrolled_range, g.enrolled_variance, d.enrolled_students_variance, d.enrolled_students_stddev FROM dept_enroll_stats_grad g JOIN dept_enroll_stats_desc d ON g.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY g.enrolled_range DESC;"]

question: For each academic year and department name where the number of enrolled students is greater than 5, what are the academic year, academic year description, geometric mean of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during that year (considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students), department name, number of unique subjects offered, the minimum start date of the academic term, and the name of the school offering the most subjects in that department and year, along with the count of subjects offered by that school? sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH GeometricMeanEnrollment AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_enrollment DESC ), SubjectCountMinStartDate AS ( SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_start_date FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT gme.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gme.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gme.geometric_mean_enrollment, scmsd.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, scmsd.subject_count, scmsd.min_start_date FROM GeometricMeanEnrollment gme JOIN SubjectCountMinStartDate scmsd ON gme.ACADEMIC_YEAR = scmsd.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY gme.geometric_mean_enrollment DESC, scmsd.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.geometric_mean_enrollment, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.subject_count, icte.min_start_date, ssc.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS Most_Prominent_School, ssc.School_Subject_Count FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.SUBJECT_ID) AS School_Subject_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT l.SUBJECT_ID) DESC ) AS rn FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON a.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ) ssc ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ssc.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ssc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ssc.rn = 1 ORDER BY icte.geometric_mean_enrollment DESC, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

sql: SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.ISBN IS NOT NULL AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC;

question: For each department name and course level where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics, provide the number of unique courses and the minimum CIP program code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL;
